operators.name: E
operators.doc: `E`: Euler's number `exp(1)`, the base of the natural logarithm.

operators.name: G_N
operators.doc: `G_N`: Newtonian constant of gravitation in m^3/(kg*s^2).

operators.name: I
operators.doc: `I`: the imaginary unit satisfying `I^2 = -1`.

operators.name: N_A
operators.doc: `N_A`: Avogadro constant in mol^-1 (exact SI).

operators.name: R_gas
operators.doc: `R_gas`: molar gas constant `N_A * k_B` in J/(mol*K).

operators.name: a_0
operators.doc: `a_0`: Bohr radius in m.

operators.name: abs
operators.doc: `abs(x)`: absolute value (or complex modulus) `|x|`.

operators.name: acos
operators.doc: `acos(x)`: principal inverse cosine of `x`, in `[0, pi]` for real `x` in `[-1, 1]`.

operators.name: acos_branch
operators.doc: `acos_branch(z, k, s)`: branch `(k, s)` of the inverse cosine `2*k*pi + s * acos(z)` with sign `s` in `{+1, -1}`.

operators.name: acosh
operators.doc: `acosh(x)`: principal inverse hyperbolic cosine `ln(x + sqrt(x^2 - 1))`.

operators.name: acosh_branch
operators.doc: `acosh_branch(z, k)`: branch `k` of the inverse hyperbolic cosine.

operators.name: acot
operators.doc: `acot(x)`: principal inverse cotangent `atan(1 / x)`.

operators.name: acoth
operators.doc: `acoth(x)`: inverse hyperbolic cotangent `atanh(1 / x)`.

operators.name: acsc
operators.doc: `acsc(x)`: principal inverse cosecant `asin(1 / x)`.

operators.name: acsch
operators.doc: `acsch(x)`: inverse hyperbolic cosecant `asinh(1 / x)`.

operators.name: action
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `action(L, y, path, x, a, b)`: substitutes `path` for `y` in Lagrangian `L` and forms the definite action integral `defint(L[y:=path], x, a, b)`.

operators.name: add
operators.doc: N-ary sum. Associative and commutative.

operators.name: adjoint_group
operators.doc: `adjoint_group(g, X)`: adjoint group action `Ad_g(X) = g X g^-1` for invertible matrix `g` and Lie algebra element `X`.

operators.name: adjoint_rep
operators.doc: `adjoint_rep(X, basis[, coords])`: matrix of the adjoint map `ad_X` in `basis`, with column `j` holding the coordinates of `[X, e_j]`.

operators.name: adjugate
operators.doc: `adjugate(A)`: classical adjugate (transpose of cofactor matrix) of square matrix `A`.

operators.name: advect_fd
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Tensor<_, Real>, Real, Real) -> Tensor<_, Real>
operators.doc: `advect_fd(velocity, u0, t_end, steps)`: Lax-Wendroff finite-difference advection solver for `u_t + v . grad u = 0`.

operators.name: advect_fd_upwind
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Tensor<_, Real>, Real, Real) -> Tensor<_, Real>
operators.doc: `advect_fd_upwind(velocity, u0, t_end, steps)`: first-order monotone upwind finite-difference advection solver.

operators.name: airfoil_equation
operators.doc: `airfoil_equation(f, x, t)`: inversion of the finite Hilbert transform on `[-1, 1]`.

operators.name: airyai
operators.doc: `airyai(x)`: Airy function of the first kind `Ai(x)`.

operators.name: airyaiprime
operators.doc: `airyaiprime(x)`: derivative `Ai'(x)` of the Airy function of the first kind.

operators.name: airybi
operators.doc: `airybi(x)`: Airy function of the second kind `Bi(x)`.

operators.name: airybiprime
operators.doc: `airybiprime(x)`: derivative `Bi'(x)` of the Airy function of the second kind.

operators.name: algebraic_connectivity
operators.doc: Computes the algebraic connectivity (second smallest Laplacian eigenvalue) of undirected graph `g`.

operators.name: all_models
operators.doc: `all_models(formula)`: enumerates all satisfying Boolean assignments of `formula`.

operators.name: amg_solve
signatures: (Tensor<2, Real>, Tensor<1, Real>, Real, Symbol) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `amg_solve(entries, b, tol, kind)`: solve sparse `A x = b` by algebraic multigrid (`ruge_stuben` or `smoothed_aggregation`).

operators.name: and
operators.doc: `and(p1, p2, ...)`: variadic logical conjunction, true when all operands are true.

operators.name: anderson_fixed_point
operators.doc: `anderson_fixed_point(g, vars, x0, tol)`: fixed point `x = g(x)` by Anderson acceleration starting from `x0` within tolerance `tol`.

operators.name: angerj
operators.doc: `angerj(nu, x)`: Anger function `J_nu(x) = (1/pi) int_0^pi cos(nu*theta - x*sin(theta)) dtheta`.

operators.name: angle
operators.doc: `angle(u, v)`: angle in radians between vectors `u` and `v`.

operators.name: angular_momentum
operators.doc: `angular_momentum(r, p)`: orbital angular momentum `r x p`.

operators.name: angular_momentum_z
operators.doc: `angular_momentum_z(phi)`: z-component angular momentum operator `-i hbar d/dphi`.

operators.name: annulus_neg_root
signatures: (Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real) -> Real
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `annulus_neg_root(nu, a, b, alpha1, beta1, alpha2, beta2, k)`: `k`-th negative radial Sturm-Liouville root on the annulus `[a, b]`.

operators.name: annulus_root
signatures: (Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real) -> Real
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `annulus_root(nu, a, b, alpha1, beta1, alpha2, beta2, k)`: `k`-th positive radial Bessel-cross-product root on the annulus `[a, b]`.

operators.name: anova
operators.doc: `anova(groups)`: one-way analysis of variance returning `list(f_statistic, p_value)` for a list of sample `groups`.

operators.name: antidifference
operators.doc: `antidifference(t, k)`: computes a closed-form antidifference `T(k)` satisfying `T(k+1) - T(k) = t(k)` (Gosper's algorithm).

operators.name: apart
operators.doc: `apart(expr, var)`: computes the partial fraction decomposition of rational `expr` with respect to `var`.

operators.name: appell_f1
signatures: (Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real) -> Real
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `appell_f1(a, b1, b2, c, x, y)`: Appell hypergeometric function `F_1(a; b1, b2; c; x, y)`.

operators.name: apply
operators.doc: Application of an undetermined function: `apply(f, args...)`.

operators.name: apply_transform
operators.doc: Applies homogeneous transform matrix `M` to point `p` (appending `1` if `p` is one dimension short and performing perspective divide).

operators.name: apply_transform_vector
operators.doc: Applies homogeneous transform matrix `M` to direction vector `v` (appending `0` if `v` is one dimension short).

operators.name: are_orthogonal
operators.doc: `are_orthogonal(f, g, x, a, b)`: `true` if `<f, g> = int_a^b conj(f) g dx = 0`.

operators.name: arg
operators.doc: `arg(z)`: principal argument (phase angle) of `z` in `(-pi, pi]`.

operators.name: asec
operators.doc: `asec(x)`: principal inverse secant `acos(1 / x)`.

operators.name: asech
operators.doc: `asech(x)`: principal inverse hyperbolic secant `acosh(1 / x)`.

operators.name: asin
operators.doc: `asin(x)`: principal inverse sine of `x`, in `[-pi/2, pi/2]` for real `x` in `[-1, 1]`.

operators.name: asin_branch
operators.doc: `asin_branch(z, k)`: branch `k` of the inverse sine `k*pi + (-1)^k * asin(z)`.

operators.name: asinh
operators.doc: `asinh(x)`: inverse hyperbolic sine `ln(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1))`.

operators.name: asinh_branch
operators.doc: `asinh_branch(z, k)`: branch `k` of the inverse hyperbolic sine.

operators.name: asymptotic
operators.doc: `asymptotic(f, x, n)`: asymptotic expansion of `f(x)` as `x -> oo` up to order `n`.

operators.name: at
operators.doc: `at(f, x, a)`: boundary or point evaluation `f|_{x = a}` used in PDE initial/boundary conditions.

operators.name: atan
operators.doc: `atan(x)`: principal inverse tangent of `x`, in `(-pi/2, pi/2)` for real `x`.

operators.name: atan2
operators.doc: `atan2(y, x)`: two-argument arctangent of `(y, x)`, giving the angle in `(-pi, pi]` from the positive x-axis.

operators.name: atan_branch
operators.doc: `atan_branch(z, k)`: branch `k` of the inverse tangent `k*pi + atan(z)`.

operators.name: atanh
operators.doc: `atanh(x)`: inverse hyperbolic tangent `ln((1 + x) / (1 - x)) / 2`.

operators.name: atanh_branch
operators.doc: `atanh_branch(z, k)`: branch `k` of the inverse hyperbolic tangent.

operators.name: baker_campbell_hausdorff
operators.doc: `baker_campbell_hausdorff(X, Y, n[, coords])`: Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff series `log(exp(X) exp(Y))` truncated at order `n <= 4`.
examples: baker_campbell_hausdorff(list(list(a, 0), list(0, b)), list(list(c, 0), list(0, d)), 4)

operators.name: ballot
operators.doc: `ballot(up, down)`: ballot number `C(up + down, down) * (up - down + 1) / (up + 1)` for `up >= down`.

operators.name: bandwidth_scott
operators.doc: `bandwidth_scott(sample)`: Scott's rule-of-thumb kernel density bandwidth for `sample`.

operators.name: bandwidth_silverman
operators.doc: `bandwidth_silverman(sample)`: Silverman's rule-of-thumb kernel density bandwidth for `sample`.

operators.name: barycentric
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>) -> Tensor<1, Float>
(Tensor<1, Float>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: Computes numeric barycentric coordinates `list(u, v, w)` of point `p` with respect to triangle `(a, b, c)`.

operators.name: bayes_update
operators.doc: `bayes_update(prior, likelihood, data)`: conjugate Bayesian posterior distribution given `prior`, `likelihood` model, and `data`.

operators.name: bch_decode
operators.doc: Decodes a shortened binary BCH codeword `c` correcting up to `t` bit errors.

operators.name: bch_encode
operators.doc: Encodes `data` bits with a shortened binary BCH code capable of correcting `t` bit errors.

operators.name: bdd
operators.doc: `bdd(formula)`: constructs the canonical reduced ordered binary decision diagram (ROBDD) representation of `formula`.

operators.name: bdd_size
operators.doc: `bdd_size(formula)`: returns the number of decision nodes in the ROBDD of `formula`.

operators.name: bei
operators.doc: `bei(n, x)`: Kelvin function `bei_n(x)` of integer order `n`.

operators.name: bell
operators.doc: `bell(n)`: `n`-th Bell number, counting partitions of an `n`-element set.

operators.name: ber
operators.doc: `ber(n, x)`: Kelvin function `ber_n(x)` of integer order `n`.

operators.name: bernoulli
operators.doc: `bernoulli(p)`: Bernoulli distribution with success probability `p`.

operators.name: bernoulli_number
operators.doc: `bernoulli_number(n)`: `n`-th Bernoulli number `B_n` (with `B_1 = -1/2`).

operators.name: bessel_differential_equation
operators.doc: `bessel_differential_equation(y, x, n)`: Bessel differential equation `x^2 y'' + x y' + (x^2 - n^2) y = 0`.

operators.name: bessel_i_complex
operators.doc: `bessel_i_complex(nu, re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the modified Bessel function of the first kind `I_nu(re + i*im)` for real order `nu`.

operators.name: bessel_j_complex
operators.doc: `bessel_j_complex(nu, re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the Bessel function of the first kind `J_nu(re + i*im)` for real order `nu`.

operators.name: bessel_k0
operators.doc: `bessel_k0(x)`: modified Bessel function of the second kind of order zero `K_0(x)`.

operators.name: bessel_k1
operators.doc: `bessel_k1(x)`: modified Bessel function of the second kind of order one `K_1(x)`.

operators.name: bessel_neg_root
operators.doc: `bessel_neg_root(nu, h)`: unique positive `s` such that `s I_nu'(s) + h I_nu(s) = 0` (corresponding to negative eigenvalue `-s^2`).

operators.name: bessel_root
operators.doc: `bessel_root(nu, h, k)`: `k`-th positive root of the Robin Bessel equation `z J_nu'(z) + h J_nu(z) = 0`.

operators.name: bessel_zero
operators.doc: `bessel_zero(nu, k)`: `k`-th positive zero `j_{nu, k}` of the Bessel function `J_nu(z)`.

operators.name: besseli
operators.doc: `besseli(nu, x)`: modified Bessel function of the first kind `I_nu(x)`.

operators.name: besselj
operators.doc: `besselj(nu, x)`: Bessel function of the first kind `J_nu(x)`.

operators.name: besselk
operators.doc: `besselk(nu, x)`: modified Bessel function of the second kind `K_nu(x)`.

operators.name: bessely
operators.doc: `bessely(nu, x)`: Bessel function of the second kind `Y_nu(x)`.

operators.name: best_approximation
operators.doc: `best_approximation(f, basis, x, a, b)`: `L^2([a, b])` orthogonal projection of `f` onto `span(basis)`.

operators.name: beta
operators.doc: `beta(x, y)`: Euler beta function `B(x, y) = Gamma(x) Gamma(y) / Gamma(x + y)`.

operators.name: beta_dist
operators.doc: `beta_dist(a, b)`: beta distribution with shape parameters `a` and `b`.

operators.name: beta_reg
operators.doc: `beta_reg(a, b, x)`: regularized incomplete beta function `I_x(a, b) = B(x; a, b) / B(a, b)`.

operators.name: betti_at_radius
operators.doc: Computes `list(b0, ..., b_max_dim)` of Betti numbers for the Vietoris-Rips complex of `points` at radius `eps`.

operators.name: bezier
operators.doc: Evaluates a Bezier curve with control points `P` at parameter `t` using de Casteljau's algorithm.

operators.name: bezier_derivative
operators.doc: Evaluates the derivative of a Bezier curve with control points `P` at parameter `t`.

operators.name: bezier_split
operators.doc: Splits a Bezier curve with control points `P` at parameter `t0`, returning `list(left, right)` control polygons.

operators.name: bicgstab_l_solve
signatures: (Tensor<2, Real>, Tensor<1, Real>, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `bicgstab_l_solve(a, b, tol)`: solve general linear system `A x = b` by BiCGSTAB(l) to relative tolerance `tol`.

operators.name: big_o
operators.doc: `big_o(term)`: Landau big-O remainder term representing omitted higher-order terms of order `term`.

operators.name: bigomega
operators.doc: `bigomega(n)`: number of prime factors of `n` counted with multiplicity (`Omega(n)`).

operators.name: binomial
operators.doc: `binomial(n, k)`: binomial coefficient `C(n, k) = n! / (k! (n - k)!)`.

operators.name: binomial_dist
operators.doc: `binomial_dist(n, p)`: binomial distribution with `n` trials and success probability `p`.

operators.name: binomial_mod
operators.doc: `binomial_mod(n, k, p)`: binomial coefficient `C(n, k) mod p` for prime `p` via Lucas's theorem.

operators.name: binomial_test
operators.doc: `binomial_test(k, n, p)`: exact two-sided binomial test p-value for `k` successes in `n` trials under null probability `p`.

operators.name: binomial_trials
operators.doc: `binomial_trials(n)`: inert binomial likelihood descriptor with `n` trials for Bayesian updates.

operators.name: biweight_location
operators.doc: `biweight_location(x, c)`: Tukey biweight M-estimator of location for `x` with tuning constant `c`.

operators.name: blackman_window
operators.doc: `blackman_window(n)`: `n`-point symmetric Blackman window sequence.

operators.name: bloch_wave
operators.doc: `bloch_wave(k, r, u)`: Bloch wavefunction `exp(i k . r) * u` with wavevector `k` and periodic part `u`.

operators.name: boltzmann_distribution
operators.doc: `boltzmann_distribution(E, T, Z)`: canonical Boltzmann probability `exp(-E / (k_B T)) / Z`.

operators.name: boltzmann_entropy
operators.doc: `boltzmann_entropy(Omega)`: statistical entropy `S = k_B ln(Omega)`.

operators.name: bootstrap_ci
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Symbol, Real, Real, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `bootstrap_ci(data, statistic, alpha, resamples, seed)`: `list(lo, hi)` percentile bootstrap confidence interval of level `1 - alpha`.

operators.name: bose_einstein_distribution
operators.doc: `bose_einstein_distribution(E, mu, T)`: Bose-Einstein mean occupation number at energy `E`, chemical potential `mu`, temperature `T`.

operators.name: bottleneck_distance
operators.doc: Computes the bottleneck distance between two persistence diagrams `D1` and `D2` (lists of `list(birth, death)`).

operators.name: boundary
operators.doc: `boundary(M)`: oriented `(k-1)`-chain boundary `dM` of a `k`-cell or `k`-chain `M`.
examples: boundary(cell(list(x, y), list(x, y), list(list(0, 1), list(0, 1))))
boundary(boundary(cell(list(x, y), list(x, y), list(list(0, 1), list(0, 1)))))

operators.name: box_counting
operators.doc: Estimates the box-counting dimension of `points` using `k` automatic scales or an explicit list of box sizes.

operators.name: bracelets
operators.doc: `bracelets(n, k)`: number of distinct `k`-ary bracelets of length `n` under rotation and reflection.

operators.name: braket
operators.doc: `braket(phi, psi, x)`: inner product `int_{-oo}^{oo} conj(phi) psi dx`.

operators.name: braket_on
operators.doc: `braket_on(phi, psi, x, a, b)`: inner product `int_a^b conj(phi) psi dx` on `[a, b]`.

operators.name: branch_cut
operators.doc: `branch_cut(f, z)`: list of `ray(p, theta)` branch cuts of principal multi-valued functions in `f(z)`.

operators.name: bravais_lattices
operators.doc: Returns the 14 Bravais lattices as `list(pearson_symbol, system, centering, holohedry)`.

operators.name: bspline
operators.doc: Evaluates a B-spline of `degree` with control points `P` and `knots` at numeric parameter `t` using de Boor's algorithm.

operators.name: burning_ship_escape
operators.doc: Computes the Burning Ship fractal escape time at `c = cr + i*ci` up to `max_iter` iterations.

operators.name: c_0
operators.doc: `c_0`: speed of light in vacuum (299792458 m/s, exact SI).

operators.name: cad
operators.doc: `cad(polys, vars)`: computes a cylindrical algebraic decomposition sample-point cell list for `polys` over `vars`.

operators.name: cad_cells
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<1, { _0: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _1: Tensor<1, Bool>, _2: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>> }>
operators.doc: `cad_cells(polys, vars)`: decomposes `R^n` over `vars` into sign-invariant cylindrical algebraic decomposition cells for `polys`.

operators.name: cancel
operators.doc: `cancel(expr)`: cancels common polynomial factors between numerator and denominator of `expr`.

operators.name: canonical_momentum
operators.doc: `canonical_momentum(L, y, x)`: computes the canonical conjugate momentum `dL/dy'` (or list of momenta) for Lagrangian `L` and coordinate(s) `y` with respect to `x`.
examples: canonical_momentum(diff(y(t), t)^3 + diff(x(t), t)^2, list(x(t), y(t)), t)

operators.name: carmichael
operators.doc: `carmichael(n)`: Carmichael's lambda function `lambda(n)`, the exponent of `(Z/nZ)^*`.

operators.name: carnot_efficiency
operators.doc: `carnot_efficiency(Tc, Th)`: Carnot thermal efficiency `1 - T_c / T_h`.

operators.name: casimir_eigenvalue
operators.doc: `casimir_eigenvalue(T, hw)`: quadratic Casimir eigenvalue `(hw, hw + 2*rho)` for irrep `V(hw)` of type `T`.

operators.name: catalan
operators.doc: `catalan(n)`: `n`-th Catalan number `C(2n, n) / (n + 1)`.

operators.name: catmull_rom
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: Evaluates a Catmull-Rom spline segment between `p1` and `p2` using `(p0, p1, p2, p3, t)`.

operators.name: cauchy
operators.doc: `cauchy(x0, gamma)`: Cauchy-Lorentz distribution with location `x0` and scale `gamma`.

operators.name: cauchy_derivative
operators.doc: `cauchy_derivative(f, z, a, n)`: Cauchy integral `∮ f(z) / (z - a)^(n + 1) dz` around `a`.

operators.name: cauchy_integral
operators.doc: `cauchy_integral(f, z, a)`: Cauchy integral `∮ f(z) / (z - a) dz` around `a`.

operators.name: cayley_hamilton
operators.doc: `cayley_hamilton(A)`: evaluate the characteristic polynomial of `A` at `A` (verifies `p(A) = 0`).

operators.name: cdf
operators.doc: `cdf(d, x)`: cumulative distribution function `P(X <= x)` of distribution `d` at point `x`.

operators.name: ceil
operators.doc: `ceil(x)`: smallest integer greater than or equal to `x`.

operators.name: cell
operators.doc: `cell(phi, params, bounds)`: oriented `k`-cell parametrized by `phi(params)` over parameter box `bounds`.

operators.name: central_binomial
operators.doc: `central_binomial(n)`: central binomial coefficient `C(2n, n)`.

operators.name: central_moment_of
operators.doc: `central_moment_of(d, k)`: `k`-th central moment `E[(X - E[X])^k]` of distribution `d`.

operators.name: centripetal_acceleration
operators.doc: `centripetal_acceleration(v, r)`: centripetal acceleration magnitude `v^2 / r` for speed `v` and radius `r`.

operators.name: cfrac
operators.doc: `cfrac(x)`: continued fraction expansion `[a0, a1, ...]` of rational or quadratic-irrational `x`.

operators.name: chain
operators.doc: `chain(terms)`: formal linear combination `list(list(mult, cell), ...)` of oriented cells.

operators.name: character_adams
operators.doc: Computes the `k`-th Adams operation `g -> chi(g^k)` on class function `chi` of finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_alt_square
operators.doc: Computes the alternating (exterior) square `(chi(g)^2 - chi(g^2)) / 2` of class function `chi` on finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_conjugate
operators.doc: Computes the complex conjugate `conj(chi)` of class function `chi` on finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_decompose
operators.doc: Decomposes class function `chi` into multiplicities of the irreducible characters of finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_inner_product
operators.doc: Computes the character inner product `(1/|G|) * sum_{g in G} chi(g) * conj(psi(g))` for class functions `chi` and `psi`.

operators.name: character_is_irreducible
operators.doc: Returns `true` if class function `chi` of finite group `G` has `<chi, chi> = 1`.

operators.name: character_of_matrices
operators.doc: Computes the class function (traces at conjugacy class representatives) of matrix representation `mats` of `G`.

operators.name: character_projection
operators.doc: Computes the isotypic projection matrix `(d_i/|G|) * sum_{g in G} conj(chi_i(g)) * M(g)` onto the `i`-th irreducible component.

operators.name: character_regular
operators.doc: Returns the character of the regular representation of finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_sym_square
operators.doc: Computes the symmetric square `(chi(g)^2 + chi(g^2)) / 2` of class function `chi` on finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_table_is_orthogonal
operators.doc: Verifies row and column orthogonality of the computed character table of finite group `G`.

operators.name: character_tensor
signatures: (group, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes the pointwise (tensor) product `chi * psi` of two class functions on finite group `G`.

operators.name: charfn
operators.doc: `charfn(d, t)`: characteristic function `E[exp(i t X)]` of distribution `d` at argument `t`.

operators.name: charpoly
operators.doc: `charpoly(A, lambda)`: characteristic polynomial `det(lambda*I - A)` in `lambda`.

operators.name: chebyshev_approx
operators.doc: `chebyshev_approx(f, x, a, b)`: adaptive Chebyshev polynomial interpolant of `f(x)` on `[a, b]` returned as `chebyshev_series(...)`.

operators.name: chebyshev_differential_equation
operators.doc: `chebyshev_differential_equation(y, x, n)`: Chebyshev differential equation `(1 - x^2) y'' - x y' + n^2 y = 0`.

operators.name: chebyshev_series
operators.doc: `chebyshev_series(t, c0, ..., cn)`: evaluate the Chebyshev series `sum c_k T_k(t)` via Clenshaw's recurrence.

operators.name: chebyshevt
operators.doc: `chebyshevt(n, x)`: Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind `T_n(x)`.

operators.name: chebyshevu
operators.doc: `chebyshevu(n, x)`: Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind `U_n(x)`.

operators.name: check_analytic
operators.doc: `check_analytic(f, z)`: `true` if `f(z)` satisfies the Cauchy-Riemann equations, `false` otherwise.

operators.name: check_jacobi
operators.doc: `check_jacobi(basis[, coords])`: `true` if the Jacobi identity `[x, [y, z]] + [y, [z, x]] + [z, [x, y]] = 0` holds for all basis triples, `false` otherwise.
examples: check_jacobi(list(list(list(a, 0), list(0, b)), list(list(c, 0), list(0, d))))

operators.name: chi
operators.doc: `chi(x)`: hyperbolic cosine integral `Chi(x) = gamma + ln|x| + int_0^x (cosh(t) - 1)/t dt`.

operators.name: chi_squared
operators.doc: `chi_squared(k)`: chi-squared distribution with `k` degrees of freedom.

operators.name: chi_squared_test
operators.doc: `chi_squared_test(observed, expected)`: Pearson's chi-squared goodness-of-fit test returning `list(statistic, p_value)`.
examples: chi_squared_test(list(a, b, c), list(d, d, d))

operators.name: cholesky
operators.doc: `cholesky(A)`: lower-triangular Cholesky factor `L` with `A = L L^T` for positive-definite `A`.

operators.name: christoffel
operators.doc: `christoffel(g, vars)`: Christoffel symbols of the second kind `Gamma^k_ij` for metric `g` in `vars`.

operators.name: christoffel1
operators.doc: `christoffel1(g, vars)`: Christoffel symbols of the first kind `Gamma_kij` for metric `g` in `vars`.

operators.name: ci
operators.doc: `ci(x)`: cosine integral `Ci(x) = -int_x^infty cos(t)/t dt`.

operators.name: circle
operators.doc: `circle(c, r)`: counter-clockwise circular contour with center `c` and radius `r`.

operators.name: clebsch_gordan
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `clebsch_gordan(j1, m1, j2, m2, J, M)`: exact Clebsch-Gordan coefficient `<j1 m1; j2 m2 | J M>` via Racah's formula (half-integers allowed), returned as `+-sqrt(q)`.

operators.name: cnf
operators.doc: `cnf(formula)`: converts propositional `formula` to conjunctive normal form.

operators.name: code_min_distance
operators.doc: Computes the minimum pairwise Hamming distance among a list of equal-length codewords.

operators.name: code_rate
operators.doc: Computes the code rate `k / n` as a rational number for message length `k` and block length `n`.

operators.name: coeff
operators.doc: `coeff(poly, var, n)`: returns the coefficient of `var^n` in polynomial `poly`.

operators.name: coefficient_of_variation
operators.doc: `coefficient_of_variation(xs)`: coefficient of variation `std / mean` of list `xs`.

operators.name: cofactors
operators.doc: `cofactors(A)`: cofactor matrix of square matrix `A`.

operators.name: collect
operators.doc: `collect(expr, var)`: groups terms of `expr` by powers of `var`.

operators.name: colspace
operators.doc: `colspace(A)`: basis of the column space of matrix `A`.

operators.name: commutator
operators.doc: `commutator(A, B, psi)`: action `[A, B] psi = A(B(psi)) - B(A(psi))` of the operator commutator.

operators.name: commutator_table
operators.doc: `commutator_table(basis[, coords])`: matrix `list(list([e_i, e_j]))` of all pairwise Lie brackets of `basis`.

operators.name: companion
operators.doc: `companion(p, x)`: Frobenius companion matrix of polynomial `p` in variable `x`.

operators.name: complex_map_fixed_points
operators.doc: Finds fixed points solving `f(z) = z` for map `f` in variable `z`.

operators.name: complex_map_stability
operators.doc: Computes the stability multiplier `|f'(z0)|` of complex map `f` in `z` at `z0`.

operators.name: component
operators.doc: `component(T, indices)`: entry of tensor `T` at 1-based index list `indices`.

operators.name: compositions
operators.doc: `compositions(n, k)`: number of compositions of `n` into `k` positive integer parts, `C(n - 1, k - 1)`.

operators.name: conditional_entropy
operators.doc: `conditional_entropy(mat)`: conditional entropy `H(Y | X) = H(X, Y) - H(X)` for joint probability matrix `mat`.

operators.name: confidence_interval
operators.doc: `confidence_interval(sample, level)`: confidence interval `list(lo, hi)` for the population mean at confidence level `level` via Student's t-distribution.

operators.name: conj
operators.doc: `conj(z)`: complex conjugate `re(z) - I * im(z)` of `z`.

operators.name: conservation_laws
operators.doc: `conservation_laws(pde, u)`: conserved densities and fluxes of `pde` for unknown `u`.
examples: conservation_laws(u(x, t)*diff(u(x, t), x) + diff(u(x, t), t) + diff(diff(diff(u(x, t), x), x), x) = 0, u(x, t))
conservation_laws(u(x, t)*diff(u(x, t), x) + diff(u(x, t), t) = diff(diff(u(x, t), x), x), u(x, t))

operators.name: continue_along
operators.doc: `continue_along(f, z, points, order)`: Taylor expansion of `f(z)` at the last point, analytically continued along `points`.

operators.name: contour_integral
operators.doc: `contour_integral(f, z, C)`: contour integral of `f(z)` along contour `C` (`circle`, `polygon`, or `path`).

operators.name: contour_integral_residue_theorem
operators.doc: `contour_integral_residue_theorem(f, z, poles)`: `2*pi*I` times the sum of residues of `f(z)` at the listed poles.

operators.name: contract
operators.doc: `contract(T, i, j)`: trace of tensor `T` over 1-based index slots `i` and `j`.

operators.name: conv_encode
operators.doc: Encodes bit list `data` using a rate-1/2 convolutional encoder.

operators.name: convergents
operators.doc: `convergents(x, n)`: first `n` continued-fraction convergents `p_k / q_k` of `x`.

operators.name: converges
operators.doc: `converges(term, k)`: tests convergence of infinite series `sum_{k} term(k)`.

operators.name: convert
operators.doc: `convert(qty, target_unit)`: converts quantity `qty` to compatible `target_unit`.

operators.name: convolution
operators.doc: `convolution(f, g, t)`: continuous convolution `(f * g)(t)`.

operators.name: convolve
operators.doc: `convolve(f, g, t)`: continuous convolution `(f * g)(t)`.

operators.name: coordinate_metric
operators.doc: `coordinate_metric(sys, vars)`: metric tensor `g = J^T J` of coordinate system `sys` in `vars`.

operators.name: correlation
operators.doc: `correlation(xs, ys)`: Pearson correlation coefficient `cov(xs, ys) / (std(xs) * std(ys))` of lists `xs` and `ys`.

operators.name: correlation_dimension
operators.doc: Estimates the correlation dimension of `points` using `k` automatic scales or an explicit list of radii.

operators.name: cos
operators.doc: `cos(x)`: cosine of angle `x` in radians.

operators.name: cosh
operators.doc: `cosh(x)`: hyperbolic cosine `(e^x + e^-x) / 2`.

operators.name: cot
operators.doc: `cot(x)`: cotangent `cos(x) / sin(x)` of angle `x` in radians.

operators.name: coth
operators.doc: `coth(x)`: hyperbolic cotangent `cosh(x) / sinh(x)`.

operators.name: coulomb_c
operators.doc: `coulomb_c(l, eta)`: Coulomb Gamow normalization factor `C_l(eta)`.

operators.name: coulomb_eigen
operators.doc: `coulomb_eigen(l, Z, n)`: numeric bound-state energy eigenvalue `E_n` of the radial Coulomb operator with angular momentum `l` and charge `Z`.

operators.name: coulomb_f
operators.doc: `coulomb_f(l, eta, rho)`: regular Coulomb wave function `F_l(eta, rho)`.

operators.name: coulomb_force
operators.doc: `coulomb_force(q1, q2, r)`: electrostatic force magnitude `q1 q2 / (4 pi epsilon_0 r^2)`.

operators.name: coulomb_fp
operators.doc: `coulomb_fp(l, eta, rho)`: derivative `F_l'(eta, rho)` with respect to `rho`.

operators.name: coulomb_g
operators.doc: `coulomb_g(l, eta, rho)`: irregular Coulomb wave function `G_l(eta, rho)`.

operators.name: coulomb_gp
operators.doc: `coulomb_gp(l, eta, rho)`: derivative `G_l'(eta, rho)` with respect to `rho`.

operators.name: coulomb_mode
operators.doc: `coulomb_mode(l, Z, n, r)`: normalized numeric bound-state radial Coulomb eigenfunction evaluated at radius `r`.

operators.name: coulomb_sigma
operators.doc: `coulomb_sigma(l, eta)`: Coulomb phase shift `sigma_l(eta) = arg Gamma(l + 1 + i*eta)`.

operators.name: coulomb_wave
operators.doc: `coulomb_wave(l, eta, k, r)`: regular Coulomb continuum wavefunction `F_l(eta, k * r)`.

operators.name: coulombs_law
operators.doc: `coulombs_law(q, r)`: electric field vector `q r / (4 pi epsilon_0 |r|^3)` of a point charge `q`.

operators.name: count_models
operators.doc: `count_models(formula)`: counts the exact number of satisfying Boolean assignments of `formula` via ROBDD.

operators.name: count_real_roots
operators.doc: `count_real_roots(poly, var, [a, b])`: counts distinct real roots of `poly` in `var` (globally or in `(a, b]`) using Sturm's theorem.

operators.name: count_zeros_poles
operators.doc: `count_zeros_poles(f, z, C)`: zeros minus poles of `f(z)` inside contour `C`, counted with multiplicity.

operators.name: covariance
operators.doc: `covariance(xs, ys)`: population covariance `(1/n) sum (x_i - mean_x)(y_i - mean_y)` of lists `xs` and `ys`.

operators.name: covariant_derivative
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `covariant_derivative(V, g, vars)`: covariant derivative `nabla_k V^i` of vector `V` with respect to metric `g` in `vars`.
examples: covariant_derivative(list(cos(theta), -sin(theta)/r), list(list(1, 0), list(0, r^2)), list(r, theta))

operators.name: covariant_divergence
operators.doc: `covariant_divergence(V, g, vars)`: covariant divergence `nabla_i V^i` of vector `V` for metric `g(vars)`.

operators.name: cp_als
signatures: (Tensor<_, Real>, Real, Real, Real) -> { _0: Tensor<1, Real>, _1: Tensor<1, Tensor<2, Real>>, _2: Real }
operators.doc: `cp_als(t, rank, sweeps, seed)`: CP decomposition of tensor `t` by alternating least squares returning `list(weights, factors, residual)`.

operators.name: cp_dense
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Tensor<1, Tensor<2, Real>>) -> Tensor<_, Real>
operators.doc: `cp_dense(weights, factors)`: reconstruct dense tensor from CP `weights` and factor matrices.

operators.name: crc16
operators.doc: Computes the 16-bit CRC-16 checksum of byte list `data`.

operators.name: crc32
operators.doc: Computes the standard 32-bit CRC-32 checksum of byte list `data`.

operators.name: crc32_finalize
operators.doc: Finalizes a running CRC-32 state `crc` by applying the final XOR mask.

operators.name: crc32_update
operators.doc: Updates a running CRC-32 state `crc` with byte list `data`.

operators.name: crc32_verify
operators.doc: Returns `true` if `crc32(data)` equals `crc`.

operators.name: crc8
operators.doc: Computes the 8-bit CRC-8 checksum of byte list `data`.

operators.name: critical_pairs
operators.doc: `critical_pairs(rules, vars)`: computes the list of critical pairs induced by overlaps among the rewrite `rules` over `vars`.
examples: critical_pairs(list(f(g(x)) = a, g(h(y)) = b), list(x, y))

operators.name: cross
operators.doc: `cross(u, v)`: 3D vector cross product `u x v`.

operators.name: cross_correlation
operators.doc: `cross_correlation(x, y)`: full linear cross-correlation of real sequences `x` and `y`.

operators.name: cross_entropy
operators.doc: `cross_entropy(p, q)`: cross-entropy `H(P, Q) = -sum p_i ln(q_i)` between probability distributions `p` and `q`.

operators.name: crt
operators.doc: `crt(remainders, moduli)`: Chinese remainder theorem solution `x` satisfying `x = r_i (mod m_i)`.

operators.name: crystal_systems
operators.doc: Returns the 7 crystal systems as `list(system, holohedry, point_groups, lattices)`.

operators.name: crystallographic_min_dimension
operators.doc: Returns the minimum lattice dimension supporting an `n`-fold crystallographic symmetry.

operators.name: crystallographic_point_groups
operators.doc: Returns the list of all 32 crystallographic point groups in Schoenflies notation.

operators.name: crystallographic_restriction
operators.doc: Tests whether an `n`-fold rotation is compatible with a lattice in 3D (or optional dimension `d`).

operators.name: csc
operators.doc: `csc(x)`: cosecant `1 / sin(x)` of angle `x` in radians.

operators.name: csch
operators.doc: `csch(x)`: hyperbolic cosecant `1 / sinh(x)`.

operators.name: cse
operators.doc: `cse(expr_or_list)`: common subexpression elimination returning a pair `(temporaries, rewritten)` of shared bindings and rewritten expressions.
examples: cse(list(exp(x + y)*sin(x + y), cos(x + y) + exp(x + y)))

operators.name: cse_cost
operators.doc: `cse_cost(expr_or_list)`: returns a pair `(before, after)` of operation counts before and after common subexpression elimination.
examples: cse_cost(list(exp(x + y)*sin(x + y), cos(x + y) + exp(x + y)))

operators.name: cubical_betti
signatures: () -> Tensor<1, Int> with 0... x Tensor<2, Int>
operators.doc: Computes `list(b0, b1)` Betti numbers of a binary image `cubical_betti(image[, 4 or 8])` with 8-connected (default) or 4-connected foreground.

operators.name: cubical_euler_characteristic
operators.doc: Computes the Euler characteristic `b0 - b1` of a binary image `cubical_euler_characteristic(image[, 4 or 8])`.

operators.name: curl
operators.doc: `curl(F, vars)`: 3D curl `nabla x F` of vector field `F`.
examples: curl(list(x*y*z, y*sin(x), x*exp(z)), list(x, y, z))

operators.name: curl_in
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `curl_in(F, sys, vars)`: physical-component curl of vector `F` in 3D orthogonal coordinate system `sys(vars)`.
examples: curl_in(list(0, r, 0), cylindrical, list(r, t, z))

operators.name: cycle_type
operators.doc: `cycle_type(perm)`: sorted list of disjoint cycle lengths of permutation `perm`.

operators.name: cyclic_group
operators.doc: Constructs the cyclic group `Z_n` of order `n` on elements `0..n-1` under addition modulo `n`.

operators.name: debye_frequency
operators.doc: `debye_frequency(v, n)`: Debye cutoff frequency `v (6 pi^2 n)^(1/3)` for sound speed `v` and atomic density `n`.

operators.name: debye_heat_capacity
operators.doc: `debye_heat_capacity(N, TD, T)`: Debye model heat capacity at temperature `T` with Debye temperature `TD`.

operators.name: definite_sum
operators.doc: `definite_sum(F, k, n)`: evaluates a definite hypergeometric sum over bound index `k` as a function of `n`.

operators.name: defint
operators.doc: `defint(f, x, a, b)`: definite integral of `f` with respect to bound variable `x` from `a` to `b`.

operators.name: degree
operators.doc: `degree(poly, var)`: returns the polynomial degree of `poly` in `var`.

operators.name: deinterleave
operators.doc: Reverses block interleaving of depth `depth` on byte list `data`.

operators.name: denest_sqrt
operators.doc: `denest_sqrt(expr)`: denests nested square roots in `expr` (e.g. `sqrt(a + b*sqrt(c))`) into simpler radical sums when possible.

operators.name: density_of_states_3d
operators.doc: `density_of_states_3d(E, m, V)`: 3D free-electron density of states at energy `E`, mass `m`, and volume `V`.

operators.name: derangements
operators.doc: `derangements(n)`: subfactorial `!n`, counting permutations of `n` elements with no fixed points.

operators.name: det
operators.doc: `det(A)`: determinant of square matrix `A`.

operators.name: diag
operators.doc: `diag(v_or_A)`: build a diagonal matrix from vector `v`, or extract the main diagonal of matrix `A`.

operators.name: diff
operators.doc: `diff(f, x)`: symbolic derivative of `f` with respect to `x`.

operators.name: diffn
operators.doc: `diffn(f, x, n)`: `n`-th order symbolic derivative of `f` with respect to `x` for non-negative integer `n`.

operators.name: digamma
operators.doc: `digamma(z)`: logarithmic derivative `psi(z) = Gamma'(z) / Gamma(z)`.

operators.name: digamma_complex
operators.doc: `digamma_complex(re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the complex digamma function `psi(z) = Gamma'(z) / Gamma(z)`.

operators.name: digraph
operators.doc: Directed graph constructor `digraph(n, edges[, hyperedges])` with vertices `0..n-1`, edge list `list(list(u, v[, w]), ...)`, and optional hyperedges.

operators.name: dihedral_group
operators.doc: Constructs the dihedral group `D_n` of order `2*n` with rotations `r0..r(n-1)` and reflections `s0..s(n-1)`.

operators.name: dim_irrep
operators.doc: `dim_irrep(T, hw)`: dimension of the irreducible representation of type `T` with highest weight `hw` (Dynkin labels).

operators.name: dimension
operators.doc: `dimension(qty)`: returns the physical dimension of quantity `qty`.

operators.name: dims
operators.doc: `dims(A)`: dimensions `list(rows, cols)` of matrix `A`.

operators.name: diophantine
operators.doc: `diophantine(eq, vars)`: integer solutions to Diophantine equation `eq` in variables `vars`.

operators.name: dirac
operators.doc: `dirac(x)`: Dirac delta distribution centered at `x = 0`.

operators.name: dirac_adjoint
operators.doc: `dirac_adjoint(psi)`: Dirac adjoint `psi^dagger gamma^0` of a four-component spinor `psi`.

operators.name: dirac_equation
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `dirac_equation(psi, m, x)`: residual `(i gamma^mu partial_mu - m) psi` of the free Dirac equation in natural units.

operators.name: dirac_gamma
operators.doc: `dirac_gamma(mu)`: 4x4 Dirac gamma matrix in the Dirac representation (`mu = 0..3`, or `5` for `gamma^5`).

operators.name: directional
operators.doc: `directional(f, vars, v)`: directional derivative `(grad f) . v` along vector `v`.

operators.name: discrete_convolution
operators.doc: `discrete_convolution(f, g, n)`: discrete convolution sum `sum_k f(k) * g(n - k)`.

operators.name: discriminant
operators.doc: `discriminant(poly, var)`: computes the discriminant of polynomial `poly` with respect to `var`.

operators.name: distance
operators.doc: `distance(a, b)`: Euclidean distance `abs(a - b)` between complex points `a` and `b`.

operators.name: div
operators.doc: `div(F, vars)`: divergence `sum_i dF_i/dx_i` of vector field `F`.

operators.name: div_in
operators.doc: `div_in(F, sys, vars)`: divergence of physical-component vector `F` in orthogonal coordinate system `sys(vars)`.

operators.name: divisor_count
operators.doc: `divisor_count(n)`: number of positive divisors `tau(n)` of positive integer `n`.

operators.name: divisor_sum
operators.doc: `divisor_sum(n)`: sum of positive divisors `sigma_1(n)` of positive integer `n`.

operators.name: divisors
operators.doc: `divisors(n)`: sorted list of all positive divisors of `n`.

operators.name: dlog
operators.doc: `dlog(g, h, n)`: discrete logarithm `k` satisfying `g^k = h (mod n)`.

operators.name: dnf
operators.doc: `dnf(formula)`: converts propositional `formula` to disjunctive normal form.

operators.name: doppler_effect
operators.doc: `doppler_effect(f, v)`: longitudinal relativistic Doppler-shifted frequency for receding velocity `v`.

operators.name: dot
operators.doc: `dot(u, v)`: Euclidean dot product `sum_i u_i v_i` of vectors `u` and `v`.

operators.name: double_factorial
operators.doc: `double_factorial(n)`: double factorial `n!! = n * (n - 2) * ...`.

operators.name: drude_conductivity
operators.doc: `drude_conductivity(n, e, tau, m)`: Drude electrical conductivity `n e^2 tau / m`.

operators.name: dsolve
signatures: () -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>> with 0... x Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `dsolve(eq_or_system, func_or_vars, [ics...])`: symbolically solves an ordinary differential equation or system of ODEs for `func_or_vars`, optionally subject to initial/boundary conditions.
examples: dsolve(list(diff(x(t), t) = y(t), diff(y(t), t) = -x(t)), list(x(t), y(t)))

operators.name: dwt2
operators.doc: `dwt2(matrix, wavelet)`: single-level 2D separable discrete wavelet transform returning `list(LL, LH, HL, HH)`.

operators.name: dwt_approx
operators.doc: `dwt_approx(x, wavelet)`: single-level discrete wavelet approximation coefficients of `x`.

operators.name: dwt_detail
operators.doc: `dwt_detail(x, wavelet)`: single-level discrete wavelet detail coefficients of `x`.

operators.name: dynkin_index
operators.doc: `dynkin_index(T, hw)`: Dynkin index `dim(V) * C(V) / dim(g)` of irrep `V(hw)` of type `T`.

operators.name: ec_add
operators.doc: Computes the elliptic curve point sum `P + Q` on curve `C`.

operators.name: ec_compress
operators.doc: Compresses an affine point `list(x, y)` to `list(x, odd)` where `odd` is `0` or `1` indicating the parity of `y`.

operators.name: ec_curve
operators.doc: Constructs an elliptic curve `list(a, b, p)` for `y^2 = x^3 + a*x + b (mod p)` with `a` and `b` reduced modulo odd prime `p`.

operators.name: ec_decompress
operators.doc: Decompresses `(C, x, odd)` to the affine point `list(x, y)` on curve `C` using Tonelli-Shanks modular square root.

operators.name: ec_double
operators.doc: Computes `2*P` on elliptic curve `C`.

operators.name: ec_is_infinity
operators.doc: Returns `true` if elliptic curve point `P` is the point at infinity `list()`.

operators.name: ec_mul
operators.doc: Computes scalar multiplication `k*P` on elliptic curve `C` for integer `k` (which may be negative).

operators.name: ec_neg
operators.doc: Returns the additive inverse `-P` of point `P` on elliptic curve `C`.

operators.name: ec_on_curve
operators.doc: Returns `true` if point `P` lies on elliptic curve `C` (including the point at infinity `list()`).

operators.name: ec_order
operators.doc: Computes the order of point `P` on elliptic curve `C` by repeated addition (up to 10^6 steps).

operators.name: ec_x
operators.doc: Returns the x-coordinate of an affine elliptic curve point `list(x, y)`.

operators.name: ec_y
operators.doc: Returns the y-coordinate of an affine elliptic curve point `list(x, y)`.

operators.name: ecdf
operators.doc: `ecdf(sample, x)`: empirical cumulative distribution function of `sample` evaluated at `x`.

operators.name: ecdh_public
operators.doc: Computes an ECDH public key `d*G` on curve `C` from generator `G` and private scalar `d`.

operators.name: ecdh_shared
operators.doc: Computes the ECDH shared secret point `d*Q` on curve `C` from private scalar `d` and peer public point `Q`.

operators.name: ecdsa_sign
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: Computes an ECDSA signature `list(r, s)` for `(C, G, n, d, h, k)` with generator `G` of order `n`, private key `d`, message hash `h`, and explicit nonce `k`.

operators.name: ecdsa_verify
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: Verifies an ECDSA signature `list(r, s)` for `(C, G, n, Q, h, sig)` against public key `Q` and message hash `h`, returning a boolean.

operators.name: egcd
operators.doc: `egcd(x, y)`: extended Euclidean algorithm returning `list(g, s, t)` with `g = s*x + t*y = gcd(x, y)`.

operators.name: ei
operators.doc: `ei(x)`: exponential integral `Ei(x) = -PV int_{-x}^infty exp(-t)/t dt`.

operators.name: eigenvals
operators.doc: `eigenvals(A)`: eigenvalues of square matrix `A`.

operators.name: eigenvects
signatures: (Tensor<2, Int>) -> Tensor<1, { _0: Dyn<term>, _1: Int, _2: Tensor<2, Dyn<term>> }>
operators.doc: `eigenvects(A)`: eigenvalues and eigenvectors of square matrix `A`.

operators.name: einstein
operators.doc: `einstein(g, vars)`: Einstein tensor `G = Ric - (R / 2) * g` for metric `g` in `vars`.

operators.name: einstein_field_equations
operators.doc: `einstein_field_equations(Ric, R, g, T)`: residual `G - (8 pi G_N / c_0^4) T` of the Einstein field equations.

operators.name: einstein_heat_capacity
operators.doc: `einstein_heat_capacity(N, TE, T)`: Einstein model heat capacity at temperature `T` with Einstein temperature `TE`.

operators.name: einstein_tensor_from
signatures: (Tensor<2, Int>, Int, Tensor<2, Int>) -> Tensor<2, Real>
(Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>) -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `einstein_tensor_from(Ric, R, g)`: Einstein tensor `G = Ric - (1/2) R g` from Ricci tensor, scalar curvature, and metric.
examples: einstein_tensor_from(ricci(list(list(a^2, 0), list(0, a^2*sin(theta)^2)), list(theta, phi)), ricci_scalar(list(list(a^2, 0), list(0, a^2*sin(theta)^2)), list(theta, phi)), list(list(a^2, 0), list(0, a^2*sin(theta)^2)))

operators.name: electric_field_from_potential
operators.doc: `electric_field_from_potential(V, vars)`: electrostatic field `-grad V` from scalar potential `V`.

operators.name: electric_field_from_potentials
signatures: (Int, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
(Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `electric_field_from_potentials(V, A, vars, t)`: electric field `-(grad V + dA/dt)` from scalar potential `V` and vector potential `A`.
examples: electric_field_from_potentials(0, list(-E0*t, 0, 0), list(x, y, z), t)
electric_field_from_potentials(-E0*x, list(-E0*t, 0, 0), list(x, y, z), t)

operators.name: em_energy_density
operators.doc: `em_energy_density(E, B)`: electromagnetic energy density `(epsilon_0 |E|^2 + |B|^2 / mu_0) / 2`.

operators.name: energy_band
operators.doc: `energy_band(k, m, E0)`: parabolic band dispersion `E0 + hbar^2 k^2 / (2 m)`.

operators.name: energy_eigenvalue
operators.doc: `energy_eigenvalue(H, psi, x)`: energy eigenvalue `E` satisfying `H psi = E psi` in variable `x`.

operators.name: entails
operators.doc: `entails(premise, conclusion)`: decides whether `premise` semantically entails `conclusion` (`true` or `false`).

operators.name: enthalpy
operators.doc: `enthalpy(U, P, V)`: enthalpy `H = U + P V`.

operators.name: entropy
operators.doc: `entropy(ps)`: Shannon entropy (in nats) `-sum p_i ln(p_i)` of probability list `ps`.

operators.name: entropy_bits
operators.doc: `entropy_bits(ps)`: Shannon entropy (in bits) `-sum p_i log2(p_i)` of probability list `ps`.

operators.name: entropy_from_helmholtz
operators.doc: `entropy_from_helmholtz(A, T)`: thermodynamic entropy `-dA/dT` from Helmholtz free energy `A`.

operators.name: entropy_of
operators.doc: `entropy_of(d)`: differential or discrete information entropy of distribution `d`.

operators.name: epsilon_0
operators.doc: `epsilon_0`: vacuum electric permittivity in F/m.

operators.name: eq
operators.doc: The equation `lhs = rhs`, as a term.

operators.name: equivalent
operators.doc: `equivalent(f, g)`: decides whether propositional formulas `f` and `g` are logically equivalent (`true` or `false`).

operators.name: erf
operators.doc: `erf(x)`: Gauss error function `(2 / sqrt(pi)) * int_0^x exp(-t^2) dt`.

operators.name: erf_complex
operators.doc: `erf_complex(re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the complex error function `erf(re + i*im)`.

operators.name: erfc
operators.doc: `erfc(x)`: complementary error function `1 - erf(x)`.

operators.name: erfcinv
operators.doc: `erfcinv(y)`: inverse complementary error function solving `erfc(x) = y`.

operators.name: erfi
operators.doc: `erfi(x)`: imaginary error function `-i * erf(i * x)`.

operators.name: euclidean_distance
operators.doc: Computes the Euclidean distance between two coordinate lists `p` and `q`.

operators.name: euler_gamma
operators.doc: `euler_gamma`: Euler-Mascheroni constant `gamma = lim_{n->infty} (H_n - ln n) ≈ 0.5772156649`.

operators.name: euler_lagrange
operators.doc: `euler_lagrange(L, y, x)`: computes the Euler-Lagrange residual expression `d/dx(dL/dy') - dL/dy` (with higher-order jet terms when present) for Lagrangian `L` and dependent variable(s) `y` of `x`.
examples: euler_lagrange(1/2*diff(x(t), t)^2 - x(t)*y(t) + 1/2*diff(y(t), t)^2, list(x(t), y(t)), t)

operators.name: euler_lagrange_equation
operators.doc: `euler_lagrange_equation(L, q, t)`: Euler-Lagrange residual `d/dt(dL/dq_dot) - dL/dq` for generalized coordinate `q(t)`.

operators.name: euler_number
operators.doc: `euler_number(n)`: `n`-th Euler number `E_n` (0 for odd `n`).

operators.name: eulerian
operators.doc: `eulerian(n, k)`: Eulerian number `A(n, k)`, counting permutations of `n` elements with `k` ascents.

operators.name: exists
operators.doc: `exists(var_or_list, formula)`: existentially quantifies Boolean variable(s) out of `formula`.

operators.name: exp
operators.doc: `exp(x)`: natural exponential function `e^x`.

operators.name: exp_map
signatures: () -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>> with 0... x Tensor<2, Int>
() -> Tensor<2, Int> with 0... x Tensor<2, Real>
() -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>> with 0... x Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `exp_map(A)` or `exp_map(A, n)`: matrix exponential `exp(A)` in closed form, or truncated Taylor polynomial `sum_{k<=n} A^k / k!`.
examples: exp_map(list(list(0, a, b), list(0, 0, c), list(0, 0, 0)))

operators.name: expand
operators.doc: `expand(expr)`: expands products and integer powers in `expr` into a sum of terms.

operators.name: expand_binomial
operators.doc: `expand_binomial(a, b, n)`: expands `(a + b)^n` via the binomial theorem `sum_{j=0}^n C(n, j) a^{n-j} b^j`.

operators.name: expand_trig
operators.doc: `expand_trig(expr)`: expands trigonometric functions of sums and integer multiples into polynomials in `sin` and `cos`.

operators.name: expect_of
operators.doc: `expect_of(d, x, expr)`: expected value `E[expr(x)]` under random variable `x ~ d`.

operators.name: expectation
operators.doc: `expectation(d)`: expected value (mean) `E[X]` of distribution `d`.

operators.name: expectation_value
operators.doc: `expectation_value(A, psi, x)`: normalized expectation value `<psi|A|psi> / <psi|psi>`.

operators.name: exponential
operators.doc: `exponential(rate)`: exponential distribution with rate parameter `rate`.

operators.name: exterior_d
operators.doc: `exterior_d(omega, vars)`: exterior derivative `d omega` of differential form `omega` in variables `vars`.

operators.name: f_dist
operators.doc: `f_dist(d1, d2)`: Fisher-Snedecor F-distribution with degrees of freedom `d1` and `d2`.

operators.name: factor
operators.doc: `factor(expr)`: factors a polynomial or rational expression into irreducible factors over the rationals.

operators.name: factor_mod
operators.doc: Factors a polynomial expression `f` in variable `x` modulo prime `p` into a product `lc * g1^m1 * ...` with coefficients in `[0, p)`.

operators.name: factorial
operators.doc: `factorial(n)`: factorial `n! = 1 * 2 * ... * n` for non-negative integer `n`.

operators.name: factorint
operators.doc: `factorint(n)`: prime factorization of `n` as `list(list(p, e), ...)`.

operators.name: falling
operators.doc: `falling(x, k)`: falling factorial `x * (x - 1) * ... * (x - k + 1)`.

operators.name: false
operators.doc: `false`: Boolean falsity constant.

operators.name: farey
operators.doc: `farey(n)`: Farey sequence `F_n` of reduced fractions in `[0, 1]` with denominator `<= n`, as `list(list(p, q), ...)`.

operators.name: fermi_dirac_distribution
operators.doc: `fermi_dirac_distribution(E, mu, T)`: Fermi-Dirac mean occupation number at energy `E`, chemical potential `mu`, temperature `T`.

operators.name: fermi_energy_3d
operators.doc: `fermi_energy_3d(n, m)`: 3D Fermi energy for electron number density `n` and mass `m`.

operators.name: fermi_wavevector_3d
operators.doc: `fermi_wavevector_3d(n)`: 3D Fermi wavevector `(3 pi^2 n)^(1/3)` for number density `n`.

operators.name: fermion_propagator
operators.doc: `fermion_propagator(p, m)`: momentum-space Dirac fermion propagator `i (p_slash + m) / (p^2 - m^2)`.

operators.name: feynman_propagator_position_space
operators.doc: `feynman_propagator_position_space(x, y, m)`: 1D Fourier transform of the scalar Feynman propagator from `x` to `y`.

operators.name: feynman_slash
operators.doc: `feynman_slash(p)`: Feynman slash `gamma^mu p_mu` for a four-vector `p = list(p0, p1, p2, p3)`.

operators.name: fft_abs
operators.doc: `fft_abs(x)`: magnitude spectrum `|DFT(x)|` of real sequence `x`.

operators.name: fft_im
operators.doc: `fft_im(x)`: imaginary part of the discrete Fourier transform of real sequence `x`.

operators.name: fft_re
operators.doc: `fft_re(x)`: real part of the discrete Fourier transform of real sequence `x`.

operators.name: fftconv
operators.doc: `fftconv(a, b)`: linear convolution of two real numeric sequences `a` and `b` via FFT.

operators.name: fgmres_solve
signatures: (Tensor<2, Real>, Tensor<1, Real>, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `fgmres_solve(a, b, tol)`: solve general linear system `A x = b` by flexible GMRES to relative tolerance `tol`.

operators.name: fibonacci
operators.doc: `fibonacci(n)`: `n`-th Fibonacci number `F_n`.

operators.name: final_value_laplace
operators.doc: `final_value_laplace(F, s)`: applies the Laplace final-value theorem `lim_{s->0} s * F(s)`.

operators.name: final_value_z
operators.doc: `final_value_z(F, z)`: applies the Z-transform final-value theorem `lim_{z->1} (z - 1) * F(z)`.

operators.name: find_constrained_extrema
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<1, { _0: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _1: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _2: Symbol, _3: Dyn<term> }>
operators.doc: `find_constrained_extrema(f, constraints, vars)`: finds extrema of `f` subject to equality `constraints` over `vars` using Lagrange multipliers.
examples: find_constrained_extrema(x + y + z, list(x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - 1), list(x, y, z))

operators.name: find_extrema
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> Tensor<1, { _0: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _1: Symbol, _2: Dyn<term> }>
operators.doc: `find_extrema(f, vars)`: finds unconstrained critical points of `f` with respect to `vars` and classifies them via the Hessian.

operators.name: first_integral
operators.doc: `first_integral(L, y, x)`: computes the Beltrami / energy first integral `L - y' * dL/dy'` for a first-order Lagrangian `L(x, y, y')`.

operators.name: first_law_thermodynamics
operators.doc: `first_law_thermodynamics(dU, Q, W)`: first law residual `dU - (Q - W)`.

operators.name: first_order_energy_correction
operators.doc: `first_order_energy_correction(V, psi, x)`: first-order perturbation energy shift `<psi|V|psi> / <psi|psi>`.

operators.name: fisher_exact
operators.doc: `fisher_exact(a, b, c, d)`: two-sided Fisher's exact test p-value for a 2x2 contingency table `[[a, b], [c, d]]`.

operators.name: floor
operators.doc: `floor(x)`: greatest integer less than or equal to `x`.

operators.name: forall
operators.doc: `forall(var_or_list, formula)`: universally quantifies Boolean variable(s) out of `formula`.

operators.name: form
operators.doc: `form(terms)`: differential form `sum c dx_i ^ ...` represented by `list(list(coeff, list(i, ...)), ...)`.

operators.name: fourier
operators.doc: `fourier(f, t, omega)`: continuous Fourier transform of `f(t)` into frequency `omega`.

operators.name: fourier_series
operators.doc: `fourier_series(f, x, L, n)`: trigonometric Fourier series of `f(x)` on `[-L, L]` up to `n` harmonics.

operators.name: fp_group
operators.doc: Constructs a `group(elements, table)` term for the finitely presented group `<gens | relators>` (order up to 720).
examples: fp_group(list(a, b), list(list(a^3), list(b^2), list(a, b, a, b)))

operators.name: fp_group_abelian_invariants
operators.doc: Computes the abelianization invariant factors (torsion factors `> 1` followed by `0` per free factor) of `<gens | relators>` via Smith normal form.

operators.name: fp_group_order
operators.doc: Computes the order of the finitely presented group `<gens | relators>` via Todd-Coxeter.

operators.name: frac
operators.doc: `frac(x)`: fractional part `x - floor(x)`.

operators.name: fredholm_eigenvalues
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Tensor<1, Symbol>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `fredholm_eigenvalues(us, vs, x, t, a, b)`: eigenvalues of the separable Fredholm operator with kernel `sum u_i(x) v_i(t)` on `[a, b]`.

operators.name: fredholm_neumann
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `fredholm_neumann(f, lambda, K, x, t, a, b, n)`: `n`-th Neumann series iterate for `y(x) = f(x) + lambda int_a^b K(x, t) y(t) dt`.

operators.name: fredholm_separable
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `fredholm_separable(f, lambda, us, vs, x, t, a, b)`: exact solution of the Fredholm equation with separable kernel `sum u_i(x) v_i(t)`.

operators.name: fredholm_solve
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `fredholm_solve(f, lambda, K, x, t, a, b)`: exact solution of the Fredholm integral equation `y(x) = f(x) + lambda int_a^b K(x, t) y(t) dt`.

operators.name: fresnel_c_complex
operators.doc: `fresnel_c_complex(re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the complex Fresnel cosine integral `C(re + i*im)`.

operators.name: fresnel_s_complex
operators.doc: `fresnel_s_complex(re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the complex Fresnel sine integral `S(re + i*im)`.

operators.name: fresnelc
operators.doc: `fresnelc(x)`: Fresnel cosine integral `int_0^x cos(pi * t^2 / 2) dt`.

operators.name: fresnels
operators.doc: `fresnels(x)`: Fresnel sine integral `int_0^x sin(pi * t^2 / 2) dt`.

operators.name: frft_im
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Tensor<1, Real>, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `frft_im(re, im, a)`: imaginary part of the discrete fractional Fourier transform of order `a` of `re + i*im`.

operators.name: frft_re
signatures: (Tensor<1, Real>, Tensor<1, Real>, Real) -> Tensor<1, Real>
operators.doc: `frft_re(re, im, a)`: real part of the discrete fractional Fourier transform of order `a` of `re + i*im`.

operators.name: from_cartesian
operators.doc: `from_cartesian(sys, coords)`: coordinates in system `sys` expressed in terms of Cartesian `coords`.

operators.name: fubini
operators.doc: `fubini(n)`: `n`-th ordered Bell (Fubini) number, counting weak orderings on `n` elements.

operators.name: function_inf_norm
operators.doc: `function_inf_norm(points)`: infinity (supremum) norm of a tabulated function `list(list(x, y), ...)`.

operators.name: function_inner
operators.doc: `function_inner(f, g)`: numerical L2 inner product of two tabulated functions `f` and `g`.

operators.name: function_l1_norm
operators.doc: `function_l1_norm(points)`: numerical L1 norm of a tabulated function `list(list(x, y), ...)`.

operators.name: function_l2_norm
operators.doc: `function_l2_norm(points)`: numerical L2 norm of a tabulated function `list(list(x, y), ...)`.

operators.name: function_normalize
operators.doc: `function_normalize(f)`: L2-normalized copy of tabulated function `f`.

operators.name: function_project
operators.doc: `function_project(f, g)`: orthogonal L2 projection of tabulated function `f` onto `g`.

operators.name: ga_apply_versor
operators.doc: `ga_apply_versor(V, X)`: versor sandwich product `V X^ V^-1` (grade-involuted `X^` for odd versor `V`).

operators.name: ga_commutator
operators.doc: `ga_commutator(A, B)`: commutator product `(A B - B A) / 2`.

operators.name: ga_conjugate
operators.doc: `ga_conjugate(A)`: Clifford conjugate scaling each grade-`k` part by `(-1)^(k*(k+1)/2)`.
examples: ga_conjugate(mv(list(3, 0, 0), list(list(0, s), list(1, a), list(3, b), list(7, c))))

operators.name: ga_dual
operators.doc: `ga_dual(A)`: dual `A I^-1` with respect to pseudoscalar `I` (or `A I` for degenerate metrics).

operators.name: ga_exp
operators.doc: `ga_exp(A)`: Clifford exponential `exp(A)` when `A^2` is a scalar.

operators.name: ga_gp
operators.doc: `ga_gp(A, B)`: geometric product `A B` of multivectors `A` and `B`.

operators.name: ga_grade
operators.doc: `ga_grade(A, k)`: grade-`k` projection `<A>_k` of multivector `A`.
examples: ga_grade(mv(list(3, 0, 0), list(list(0, s), list(1, a), list(3, b), list(7, c))), 0)

operators.name: ga_inner
operators.doc: `ga_inner(A, B)`: Hestenes inner product `sum_{r,s>0} <A_r B_s>_{|r-s|}`.

operators.name: ga_inverse
operators.doc: `ga_inverse(A)`: multiplicative inverse `A^-1` for a versor or blade with nonzero scalar square.

operators.name: ga_involute
operators.doc: `ga_involute(A)`: grade involution `A^` scaling each grade-`k` part by `(-1)^k`.
examples: ga_involute(mv(list(3, 0, 0), list(list(0, s), list(1, a), list(3, b), list(7, c))))

operators.name: ga_lcontract
operators.doc: `ga_lcontract(A, B)`: left contraction `sum_{r,s} <A_r B_s>_{s-r}`.

operators.name: ga_norm
operators.doc: `ga_norm(A)`: norm `sqrt(<A A~>_0)` of multivector `A`.

operators.name: ga_norm_squared
operators.doc: `ga_norm_squared(A)`: squared norm `<A A~>_0` of multivector `A`.

operators.name: ga_normalize
operators.doc: `ga_normalize(A)`: normalized multivector `A / ga_norm(A)`.

operators.name: ga_rcontract
operators.doc: `ga_rcontract(A, B)`: right contraction `sum_{r,s} <A_r B_s>_{r-s}`.

operators.name: ga_reverse
operators.doc: `ga_reverse(A)`: reversion `A~` scaling each grade-`k` part by `(-1)^(k*(k-1)/2)`.
examples: ga_reverse(mv(list(3, 0, 0), list(list(0, s), list(1, a), list(3, b), list(7, c))))

operators.name: ga_rotor
operators.doc: `ga_rotor(B, angle)`: rotor `exp(-angle * B_hat / 2)` for bivector `B` and rotation angle `angle`.

operators.name: ga_scalar_product
operators.doc: `ga_scalar_product(A, B)`: scalar product `<A B>_0` of multivectors `A` and `B`.

operators.name: ga_undual
operators.doc: `ga_undual(A)`: undual `A I` with respect to pseudoscalar `I`.
examples: ga_undual(ga_dual(mv(list(3, 0, 0), list(list(0, s), list(1, a), list(3, b), list(7, c)))))

operators.name: ga_wedge
operators.doc: `ga_wedge(A, B)`: outer (exterior) product `A ^ B = sum_{r,s} <A_r B_s>_{r+s}`.

operators.name: gamma
operators.doc: `gamma(z)`: Euler gamma function `Gamma(z)`.

operators.name: gamma_complex
operators.doc: `gamma_complex(re, im)`: `list(re, im)` of the complex Gamma function `Gamma(re + i*im)`.

operators.name: gamma_dist
operators.doc: `gamma_dist(shape, rate)`: gamma distribution with shape parameter `shape` and rate parameter `rate`.

operators.name: gamma_lr
operators.doc: `gamma_lr(a, x)`: regularized lower incomplete gamma function `P(a, x) = gamma(a, x) / Gamma(a)`.

operators.name: gauss_theorem
operators.doc: `gauss_theorem(F, vars, bounds)`: outward flux integral of vector field `F` over box `bounds` via the divergence theorem.

operators.name: gaussian_curvature
operators.doc: `gaussian_curvature(g, vars)`: Gaussian curvature `K = R / 2` of a 2D metric `g` in `vars`.

operators.name: gcd
operators.doc: `gcd(a, b)`: greatest common divisor of integers `a` and `b`.

operators.name: ge
operators.doc: `ge(a, b)`: greater-than-or-equal comparison `a >= b`.

operators.name: generalized_stokes
operators.doc: `generalized_stokes(omega, vars, M)`: evaluates both sides of `int_M d(omega) = int_{dM} omega` as an equation.
examples: generalized_stokes(form(list(list(x, list(2)))), list(x, y), cell(list(x, y), list(x, y), list(list(0, 1), list(0, 1))))

operators.name: geodesic_acceleration
operators.doc: `geodesic_acceleration(metric, coords)`: geodesic equation acceleration vector `-Gamma^mu_{alpha beta} u^alpha u^beta` for `metric` and `coords`.
examples: geodesic_acceleration(christoffel(list(list(1, 0), list(0, r^2)), list(r, theta)), list(u, v))

operators.name: geometric
operators.doc: `geometric(p)`: geometric distribution with success probability `p`.

operators.name: geometric_mean
operators.doc: `geometric_mean(xs)`: geometric mean `(prod x_i)^(1/n)` of list `xs`.

operators.name: gf256_add
operators.doc: Computes `a + b` (bitwise XOR) in GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_div
operators.doc: Computes `a / b` in GF(2^8) for non-zero `b`.

operators.name: gf256_exp
operators.doc: Computes `2^k` in GF(2^8) using generator `2`.

operators.name: gf256_inv
operators.doc: Computes the multiplicative inverse `a^(-1)` in GF(2^8) for non-zero `a`.

operators.name: gf256_log
operators.doc: Computes the discrete logarithm base `2` of non-zero element `a` in GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_mul
operators.doc: Computes `a * b` in GF(2^8) modulo the primitive polynomial `0x11d`.

operators.name: gf256_poly_add
operators.doc: Computes the sum `p + q` of two polynomials over GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_poly_derivative
operators.doc: Computes the formal derivative of polynomial `p` over GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_poly_divmod
operators.doc: Computes polynomial division `p / d` over GF(2^8), returning `list(quotient, remainder)`.

operators.name: gf256_poly_eval
operators.doc: Evaluates a highest-degree-first polynomial `p` over GF(2^8) at `x`.

operators.name: gf256_poly_gcd
operators.doc: Computes the monic greatest common divisor of polynomials `p` and `q` over GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_poly_mod
operators.doc: Computes the remainder of polynomial `p` divided by `d` over GF(2^8), padded to `deg(d)` coefficients.

operators.name: gf256_poly_mul
operators.doc: Computes the product `p * q` of two polynomials over GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_poly_scale
operators.doc: Multiplies polynomial `p` over GF(2^8) by scalar `c` in GF(2^8).

operators.name: gf256_pow
operators.doc: Computes `a^e` in GF(2^8) for integer exponent `e`.

operators.name: gf_add
operators.doc: Computes `(a + b) mod p` in the prime field GF(p).

operators.name: gf_coeffs
operators.doc: `gf_coeffs(f, x, count)`: extract the first `count` Taylor coefficients of generating function `f(x)` at `x = 0`.

operators.name: gf_div
operators.doc: Computes `a * b^(-1) mod p` in GF(p) when `gcd(b, p) = 1`.

operators.name: gf_inv
operators.doc: Computes the modular multiplicative inverse `a^(-1) mod p` when `gcd(a, p) = 1`.

operators.name: gf_is_one
operators.doc: Returns `true` if `a = 1 (mod p)` in GF(p).

operators.name: gf_is_zero
operators.doc: Returns `true` if `a = 0 (mod p)` in GF(p).

operators.name: gf_mul
operators.doc: Computes `(a * b) mod p` in the prime field GF(p).

operators.name: gf_neg
operators.doc: Computes `(-a) mod p` in the prime field GF(p).

operators.name: gf_pow
operators.doc: Computes `a^e mod p` in GF(p) for integer exponent `e` (negative exponents use the modular inverse).

operators.name: gf_sub
operators.doc: Computes `(a - b) mod p` in the prime field GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_add
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes the sum `f + g` of two polynomials over GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_berlekamp
operators.doc: Computes the complete factorization of polynomial `f` over a small prime field GF(p) using Berlekamp's algorithm.

operators.name: gfp_ddf
operators.doc: Computes the distinct-degree factorization of a squarefree polynomial `f` over GF(p) as `list(list(g_d, d), ...)`.

operators.name: gfp_degree
operators.doc: Returns the degree of polynomial `f` over GF(p), or `-1` for the zero polynomial.

operators.name: gfp_derivative
operators.doc: Computes the formal derivative `f'` of polynomial `f` over GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_divmod
operators.doc: Computes Euclidean polynomial division `f / g` over GF(p), returning `list(quotient, remainder)`.

operators.name: gfp_edf
operators.doc: Computes the equal-degree factorization (Cantor-Zassenhaus) of a squarefree polynomial `f` of degree `k*d` over GF(p) into irreducible factors of degree `d`.

operators.name: gfp_egcd
operators.doc: Computes the extended Euclidean algorithm on polynomials `f` and `g` over GF(p), returning `list(d, s, t)` with `s*f + t*g = d`.

operators.name: gfp_eval
operators.doc: Evaluates polynomial `f` at scalar `x` in GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_factor
operators.doc: Computes the complete factorization of polynomial `f` over GF(p) as `list(lc, list(g1, m1), ...)`, ordered by degree.

operators.name: gfp_gcd
operators.doc: Computes the monic greatest common divisor of polynomials `f` and `g` over GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_invmod
operators.doc: Computes the inverse of polynomial `f` modulo `m` over GF(p) when `gcd(f, m) = 1`.

operators.name: gfp_isirreducible
operators.doc: Tests whether polynomial `f` is irreducible over GF(p) using Rabin's irreducibility test.

operators.name: gfp_monic
operators.doc: Divides polynomial `f` by its leading coefficient modulo prime `p` to produce the monic polynomial.

operators.name: gfp_mul
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes the product `f * g` of two polynomials over GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_norm
operators.doc: Normalizes a highest-degree-first polynomial `f` over GF(p) by reducing coefficients modulo `p` and stripping leading zeros.

operators.name: gfp_powmod
operators.doc: Computes `f^e mod m` for polynomial `f`, non-negative integer `e`, and modulus polynomial `m` over GF(p).

operators.name: gfp_squarefree
operators.doc: Computes the squarefree factorization of polynomial `f` over GF(p) as `list(list(g1, m1), ...)` using Yun's algorithm.

operators.name: gfp_sub
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: Computes the difference `f - g` of two polynomials over GF(p).

operators.name: gfx_add
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: Computes `(a + b) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gfx_div
operators.doc: Computes `a * b^(-1) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m) when `b` is invertible modulo `m`.

operators.name: gfx_inv
operators.doc: Computes the multiplicative inverse `a^(-1) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gfx_mul
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes `(a * b) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gfx_neg
operators.doc: Computes `(-a) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gfx_pow
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Int, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes `a^e mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m) for integer exponent `e`.

operators.name: gfx_reduce
operators.doc: Reduces polynomial `a` modulo `m` over GF(p) in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gfx_sub
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
operators.doc: Computes `(a - b) mod m` in the extension field GF(p)[x]/(m).

operators.name: gibbs_free_energy
operators.doc: `gibbs_free_energy(H, T, S)`: Gibbs free energy `G = H - T S`.

operators.name: gini
operators.doc: `gini(ps)`: Gini impurity `1 - sum p_i^2` of categorical distribution `ps`.

operators.name: gl_basis
operators.doc: `gl_basis(n)`: standard matrix basis `E_ij` of the general linear Lie algebra `gl(n)`.

operators.name: grad
operators.doc: `grad(f, vars)`: gradient vector `[df/dx_1, ..., df/dx_n]` of scalar expression `f`.

operators.name: grad_in
operators.doc: `grad_in(f, sys, vars)`: physical-component gradient of scalar `f` in orthogonal coordinate system `sys(vars)`.

operators.name: gram_matrix
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `gram_matrix(funcs, x, a, b)`: Gram matrix of `L^2([a, b])` inner products `<f_i, f_j>`.

operators.name: gram_schmidt
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `gram_schmidt(funcs, x, a, b)`: orthogonal basis of `span(funcs)` on `[a, b]` in `L^2(x)`.

operators.name: gram_schmidt_orthonormal
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `gram_schmidt_orthonormal(funcs, x, a, b)`: orthonormal basis of `span(funcs)` on `[a, b]` in `L^2(x)`.

operators.name: graph
operators.doc: Undirected graph constructor `graph(n, edges[, hyperedges])` with vertices `0..n-1`, edge list `list(list(u, v[, w]), ...)`, and optional hyperedges.

operators.name: graph_add_edge
operators.doc: Returns a new graph with edge `(u, v)` (and optional weight `w`, default `1`) added to `g`.

operators.name: graph_add_hyperedge
operators.doc: Returns a new graph with hyperedge `(vs, w)` added to `g`.

operators.name: graph_add_node
operators.doc: Returns a new graph with one additional isolated vertex appended.

operators.name: graph_adjacency
operators.doc: Returns the weighted adjacency matrix of graph `g` as `list(list(...))`, summing parallel edge weights.
examples: graph_adjacency(graph(3, list(list(0, 1, a), list(1, 2, b), list(0, 2, c))))

operators.name: graph_automorphisms
signatures: (graph) -> { _0: Int, _1: Tensor<2, Int>, _2: Tensor<1, Tensor<1, Int>> }
operators.doc: Computes the automorphism group of graph `g` as `list(order, generators, orbits)`.
examples: graph_automorphisms(digraph(5, list(list(0, 1), list(1, 2), list(2, 3), list(3, 4), list(4, 0))))

operators.name: graph_bellman_ford
operators.doc: Computes single-source shortest paths from `s` in graph `g` using Bellman-Ford, returning `list(list(dist, prev), ...)` or `false` on a negative cycle.

operators.name: graph_bfs
operators.doc: Returns the breadth-first search vertex visitation order starting from vertex `s` in graph `g`.
examples: graph_bfs(graph(6, list(list(0, 1, 1), list(0, 2, 1), list(1, 3, 1), list(2, 3, 1), list(4, 5, 1))), 0)

operators.name: graph_bipartite_matching
operators.doc: Computes a maximum bipartite matching of graph `g` with bipartition coloring `part`, returning matched pairs `list(list(u, v), ...)`.

operators.name: graph_blossom
operators.doc: Computes a maximum cardinality matching of general undirected graph `g` using Edmonds' blossom algorithm.

operators.name: graph_bridges
operators.doc: Returns `list(bridges, articulation_points)` of an undirected graph `g`.

operators.name: graph_canonical_form
operators.doc: Computes the canonical labeling `list(order, adjacency)` of graph `g` (up to search budget).

operators.name: graph_cartesian
operators.doc: Computes the Cartesian product `g □ h` with vertex pairs `(u, v)` numbered `u * |V(h)| + v`.

operators.name: graph_chromatic_number
operators.doc: Computes the exact chromatic number of undirected graph `g` (up to 40 vertices, no self-loops).

operators.name: graph_complement
operators.doc: Returns the complement graph of simple graph `g`.

operators.name: graph_complete
operators.doc: Constructs the undirected complete graph K_n on `n` vertices.

operators.name: graph_components
operators.doc: Returns the connected components (weakly connected for digraphs) of graph `g` as lists of vertices.
examples: graph_components(graph(6, list(list(0, 1, 1), list(0, 2, 1), list(1, 3, 1), list(2, 3, 1), list(4, 5, 1))))

operators.name: graph_cycle
operators.doc: Constructs the undirected cycle graph C_n on `n` vertices (empty if `n < 3`).

operators.name: graph_dfs
operators.doc: Returns the depth-first search vertex visitation order starting from vertex `s` in graph `g`.
examples: graph_dfs(graph(6, list(list(0, 1, 1), list(0, 2, 1), list(1, 3, 1), list(2, 3, 1), list(4, 5, 1))), 0)

operators.name: graph_dijkstra
operators.doc: Computes single-source shortest paths from `s` in non-negatively weighted graph `g` using Dijkstra's algorithm, returning `list(list(dist, prev), ...)`.

operators.name: graph_dinic
operators.doc: Computes the maximum flow from source `s` to sink `t` in graph `g` using Dinic's algorithm.

operators.name: graph_disjoint_union
operators.doc: Returns the disjoint union of graphs `g` and `h`, shifting `h`'s vertices by `|V(g)|`.

operators.name: graph_edges
operators.doc: Returns the edge list `list(list(u, v, w), ...)` of graph `g` (undirected edges listed once with `u <= v`).

operators.name: graph_edmonds_karp
operators.doc: Computes the maximum flow from source `s` to sink `t` in graph `g` using the Edmonds-Karp algorithm.

operators.name: graph_empty
operators.doc: Constructs an undirected empty graph on `n` vertices with no edges.

operators.name: graph_floyd_warshall
operators.doc: Computes the all-pairs shortest-path distance matrix of graph `g` using the Floyd-Warshall algorithm.
