operators.name: num_native_release
operators.doc: Session-local reverse AD object. Tape constructor reserves 1..65536 nodes. Linear quantity values use coherent units; addition requires matching dimensions, products/quotients and gradients propagate physical powers; transcendental arguments must be dimensionless. Opaque handles are kind checked, invalid across sessions and after release. Release dependent variables/gradients before their tape. Callbacks scope temporary handles. No native pointer/state is serialized.

operators.name: num_native_reverse_gradient_scaled
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Float[_], Int, (Tensor<1, rssn/native/ad/var/v1>) -> rssn/native/ad/var/v1) -> { value: Float[_], gradient: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, evaluations: Int }
operators.doc: Exact native AD with normalized callback variables and independent physical references: point,positive coordinate_scale,positive value_scale,max_evaluations,callback. Forward callback scalar duals are {val,deriv}; vector duals are {val:vector,deriv:vector}; all dual arithmetic is dimensionless and uses native num_dual_* operators. Reverse callbacks use checked NativeAdVar handles on an ephemeral session tape; native operations enforce same-tape identity and a65536-node limit. Output derivatives restore E/D; no numerical differencing or opaque-callback finite-difference fallback.

operators.name: num_native_richardson_derivative_scaled
operators.doc: Native finite-difference calculus with physical reference scales: point,coordinate_scale,value_scale,max_evaluations,[partial index or Jacobian output count],callback. Independent D/E units; derivative E/D, Hessian/Laplacian E/D^2. References are positive. Shared callback errors and finite evaluation budgets are preserved.

operators.name: num_native_scenario_run
operators.doc: Execute the actual native named scenario with bounded JSON parameters. The contract must be native-schema: JSON numbers use the units documented by that scenario's schema and preserve native defaults. Typed physical quantity APIs are separately exposed for each numerical engine.

operators.name: num_native_scenario_run_many
operators.doc: Execute actual native parallel run_many over bounded named JSON requests. Input records have name and parameters strings; per-request native Ok/Err results and request order are preserved, with invalid requests rejected before native allocation.

operators.name: num_native_schema_catalog
operators.doc: Serialize the actual native scenario catalog, including physical unit notes and defaults; this discovery operator does not substitute for scenario execution.

operators.name: num_native_schema_catalog_json
operators.doc: Read the native scenario catalog JSON including parameter defaults and unit notes.

operators.name: num_native_schema_infer
operators.doc: Infer the actual native scenario field type from a bounded JSON value; result is the native serialized FieldType enum.

operators.name: num_native_schema_parse_type
operators.doc: Parse native schema type syntax and return its serialized native FieldType enum if valid.

operators.name: num_native_schema_witness
operators.doc: Execute every actual native scenario on its declared example/default request and infer output schemas. All examples are preflighted against one explicit aggregate work budget before execution.

operators.name: num_native_second_derivative_scaled
operators.doc: Native finite-difference calculus with physical reference scales: point,coordinate_scale,value_scale,max_evaluations,[partial index or Jacobian output count],callback. Independent D/E units; derivative E/D, Hessian/Laplacian E/D^2. References are positive. Shared callback errors and finite evaluation budgets are preserved.

operators.name: num_native_second_order_check_scaled
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Float[_], Float[_], Float[_], Int, (Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Float[_], (Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>, (Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> String
operators.doc: Native scaled global/constrained optimization with shared actual host evaluation limit. Nelder: x,xscale,yscale,step,tol,iterations,budget,f. Differential evolution: lo,hi,xscale,yscale,population,generations,budget,seed,f. Annealing: x,xscale,yscale,step,temperature,cooling,iterations,budget,seed,f. Constrained: x,xscale,yscale,equality_scale,inequality_scale,tol,iterations,budget,f,eq,ineq. Constraints independently carry C/H units; SQP returns physical multipliers E/C and E/H, native status and second-order verdict. Second-order: x,lambda,mu,xscale,yscale,eqscale,ineqscale,budget,f,eq,ineq. No global-optimality claim; native iteration/status semantics retained.

operators.name: num_native_sequence_limit
signatures: (Int, Float[_], Float[_], Int, (Float) -> Float[_]) -> { value: Float[_], evaluations: Int }
operators.doc: Physical native series/sequence convergence. sum_series: start,max_terms,tolerance,value_scale,max_evaluations,term(Float)->E. sequence_limit omits start. Levin: max_terms,value_scale,max_evaluations,term(Int)->E; result includes native error estimate. References/tolerances are positive physical E; callback failures propagate and budgets bound actual host calls.

operators.name: num_native_sim_cutcell_default_depth
operators.doc: Default refinement depth for faces and cells.

operators.name: num_native_sim_dg_log_mean
operators.doc: Logarithmic mean `(a - b) / (ln a - ln b)` with a series for close arguments.

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_carlson_rc
operators.doc: Carlson's degenerate integral `R_C(x, y)` (`x >= 0`, `y != 0`; `y < 0` gives the Cauchy principal value).

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_carlson_rj
operators.doc: Carlson's `R_J(x, y, z, p)` for `x, y, z >= 0` (at most one zero) and `p > 0`.

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_elliptic_pi
operators.doc: Incomplete elliptic integral of the third kind.

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_elliptic_pi_complete
operators.doc: Complete elliptic integral of the third kind `Pi(n, m)` with `n < 1`, `m < 1`.

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_jacobi_int_inv_sq
operators.doc: `int_0^u dv / (1 - n sn^2(v, m))^2` with `u = F(phi, m)`, in closed form (Byrd-Friedman 336.02) through `E`, `F` and `Pi`; requires `n != 1` and `n != m`.

operators.name: num_native_sim_elliptic_jacobi_int_sn2
operators.doc: `int_0^u sn^2(v, m) dv` for the amplitude `phi = am(u)` (any real `phi`): `(u - E(phi, m)) / m` with `u = F(phi, m)`.

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_cfl_number
operators.doc: Calculates the CFL (Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy) number.

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_check_cfl_stability
operators.doc: Checks if the CFL condition is satisfied for stability.

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_diffusion_number
operators.doc: Calculates the diffusion number for stability analysis. For stability, typically r ≤ 0.5 for 1D explicit diffusion.

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_froude_number
operators.doc: Calculates the Froude number: Fr = V/√(gL)

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_mach_number
operators.doc: Calculates the Mach number: Ma = V/c

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_cfd_reynolds_number

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_fea_max_shear_stress

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_fvm_minmod

operators.name: num_native_sim_physics_fvm_van_leer
operators.doc: Van Leer limiter for MUSCL reconstruction.

signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> rssn/native/sim/split-step/v1

operators.name: num_project
operators.doc: Project a vector onto another; zero direction produces zero.

operators.name: num_quadrature_gauss_legendre_rule

operators.name: num_quadrature_halton_point

operators.name: num_range
operators.doc: Difference between sample maximum and minimum.

operators.name: num_rank_tol
operators.doc: SVD rank using a nonnegative absolute singular-value tolerance.

operators.name: num_rbf_scaled
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, String, Float[_]) -> Float[_]

operators.name: num_reflect
operators.doc: Reflect about a unit normal supplied by the caller.

operators.name: num_riemann_zeta
operators.doc: Computes the Riemann zeta function ζ(s) for real `s`.

operators.name: num_robust_bandwidth_scott
operators.doc: Scott's rule bandwidth `1.06 sd n^(-1/5)`.

operators.name: num_robust_bandwidth_silverman
operators.doc: Silverman's rule-of-thumb bandwidth `0.9 min(sd, IQR/1.34) n^(-1/5)`.

operators.name: num_robust_biweight_location
operators.doc: Tukey biweight location estimator (tuning constant `c`, 4.685 typical).

operators.name: num_robust_ecdf
operators.doc: Empirical CDF of `data` at `x`.

operators.name: num_robust_huber_location
operators.doc: Huber M-estimator of location with tuning constant `k` (1.345 is the classical choice), scale fixed to the normalised MAD.

operators.name: num_robust_iqr
operators.doc: Interquartile range (type 7 quantiles).

operators.name: num_robust_kde
operators.doc: Kernel density estimate of `data` evaluated at `x` with bandwidth `h`.

operators.name: num_robust_mad
operators.doc: Median absolute deviation; multiplied by 1.4826 when `normal` is true so it estimates the standard deviation for Gaussian data.

operators.name: num_robust_median
operators.doc: Median of `data` (NaNs ignored).

operators.name: num_robust_quantile
operators.doc: Sample quantile of `data` at probability `p` using the Hyndman-Fan definition `kind` (1..=9; 7 is the NumPy/R default). NaNs are ignored. Returns NaN for empty data or an invalid `p`/`kind`.

operators.name: num_robust_trimmed_mean
operators.doc: Mean after discarding the fraction `trim` from each tail.

operators.name: num_robust_winsorized_mean
operators.doc: Mean after replacing the lowest and highest fraction `trim` by the nearest retained values.

operators.name: num_romberg
signatures: (Float[_], Float[_], Float[_], Int, Int, (Float[_]) -> Float[_]) -> { value: Float[_], evaluations: Int, error: Float[_], converged: Bool }
operators.doc: Dimension-aware serial quadrature with a strict callback evaluation budget. Fixed rules: a,b,order,max_evaluations,callback. Romberg/tanh-sinh: a,b,tolerance,max_levels,max_evaluations,callback. Semi-infinite rules: finite_bound,tolerance,max_evaluations,callback; left-infinite integrates (-infinity,bound], right-infinite [bound,infinity). Full infinite rule: tolerance,max_evaluations,callback. Adaptive results include value,error,evaluations,converged; fixed rules report value,evaluations. Callback failures propagate unchanged.

operators.name: num_scalar_mul
operators.doc: Multiplies a vector by a scalar.

operators.name: num_schur_eigvals_generalized
operators.doc: Generalized eigenvalues `alpha_i / beta_i` of `A v = lambda B v`.

operators.name: num_schur_lyapunov
operators.doc: Solves the continuous-time Lyapunov equation `A X + X A^T = Q`.

operators.name: num_schur_norm_inf
operators.doc: Infinity norm `max_i sum_j |A_{i,j}|`.

operators.name: num_schur_qz

operators.doc: Real QZ (generalized Schur) decomposition of `(A, B)`.

operators.name: num_schur_schur
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>) -> { q: Tensor<2, Float>, t: Tensor<2, Float[_]> }
operators.doc: Real Schur decomposition `A = Q T Q^T`, where `Q` is orthogonal and `T` is quasi-upper-triangular (1x1 and 2x2 diagonal blocks).

operators.name: num_schur_sylvester

operators.doc: Solves the continuous-time Sylvester equation `A X + X B = C` via the Bartels-Stewart algorithm (real Schur reduction + block back-substitution).

operators.name: num_sde_adaptive_diag
signatures: (Float[_], Float[_], Float[_], Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Float, Int, Int, Int, Int, Int, (Float[_], Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>, (Float[_], Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { times: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, states: Tensor<2, Float[_]>, evaluations: Int, steps: Int, rejected: Int }
operators.doc: Adaptive stochastic path with exact declared callback dimensions and finite budgets. Arguments: t0,t1,positive reference_time,y0,state atol,dimensionless rtol,positive finest cells,proposal/path step budget,callback budget,nonnegative u64 seed,method code 0..9; general variants then take noise count and commutative Bool. Levy variants next take alpha,beta and use dimensionless stable noise at the reference-time scale (diffusion has state units). Jump variants next take intensity (inverse time),dimensionless constant mark vector with independent extent M, then drift,diffusion,jump callbacks sharing that M; other families finish with drift,diffusion callbacks. Brownian diffusion has state/sqrt(time) units. Method codes follow SdeMethod declaration order. Rejections reuse a bounded dyadic noise realization; resolution or work exhaustion is an error. Stable alpha<2 supports only Ito Euler/implicit Euler/theta, while alpha=2 uses the correctly scaled Brownian schemes. Jump times/marks are fixed before rejection and continuous segments stop exactly at each arrival. Local error estimates are heuristic, not global certificates.

operators.doc: Computes the n-th Bernoulli polynomial `B_n(x)`.

operators.name: num_special_bessel_i
operators.doc: Modified Bessel function of the first kind `I_ν(x)`, by `(1/π)∫_0^π e^{x cos θ} cos νθ dθ - (sin νπ/π)∫_0^∞ e^{-x cosh t - νt} dt` (`x < 0` for integer orders by parity).

operators.name: num_special_bessel_j
operators.doc: Bessel function of the first kind `J_ν(x)` for real order `ν` and real `x` (`x < 0` only for integer orders, through `J_n(-x) = (-1)^n J_n(x)`).

operators.name: num_special_bessel_k
operators.doc: Modified Bessel function of the second kind `K_ν(x)` for `x > 0`, by `∫_0^∞ e^{-x cosh t} cosh νt dt`.

operators.name: num_special_bessel_y
operators.doc: Bessel function of the second kind `Y_ν(x)` for real order and `x > 0`, by `(1/π)∫_0^π sin(x sin θ - νθ) dθ - (1/π)∫_0^∞ (e^{νt} + e^{-νt} cos νπ) e^{-x sinh t} dt`.

operators.name: num_special_beta_numerical
operators.doc: Computes the beta function, B(a, b) = Γ(a)Γ(b)/Γ(a+b).

operators.name: num_special_chebyshev_t
operators.doc: Computes the Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind `T_n(x)`.

operators.name: num_special_chebyshev_u
operators.doc: Computes the Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind `U_n(x)`.

operators.name: num_special_double_factorial
operators.doc: Computes the double factorial n!! n!! = n * (n-2) * (n-4) * ... * (1 or 2)

operators.name: num_special_exact_chebyshev_t_exact
operators.doc: `T_n(x)` over the rationals.

operators.name: num_special_exact_chebyshev_u_exact
operators.doc: `U_n(x)` over the rationals.

operators.name: num_special_exact_hermite_h_exact
operators.doc: `H_n(x)` over the rationals.

operators.name: num_special_exact_laguerre_l_exact
operators.doc: `L_n(x)` over the rationals.

operators.name: num_special_exact_legendre_p_exact
operators.doc: `P_n(x)` over the rationals.

operators.name: num_special_ext_anger_j
operators.doc: The Anger function `J_ν(x) = (1/π) ∫_0^π cos(νθ - x sin θ) dθ` for real `ν` and `x`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_appell_f1
signatures: (Float, Float, Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Float
operators.doc: Appell's first double hypergeometric function `F_1(a; b_1, b_2; c; x, y)` `= Σ_{m,n≥0} (a)_{m+n} (b_1)_m (b_2)_n / ((c)_{m+n} m! n!) x^m y^n`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_bessel_in
operators.doc: Modified Bessel function of the first kind `I_n(x)` for integer order.

operators.name: num_special_ext_bessel_in_scaled
operators.doc: Exponentially scaled modified Bessel function `e^{-|x|} I_n(x)` for integer order; finite for every finite `x` (unlike [`bessel_in`], which overflows beyond `|x| ~ 709`).

operators.name: num_special_ext_bessel_jn
operators.doc: Bessel function of the first kind `J_n(x)` for integer order.

operators.name: num_special_ext_carlson_rd
operators.doc: Carlson's `R_D(x, y, z)` for finite non-negative `x, y`, not both zero, and finite positive `z`; invalid arguments or nonconvergence return NaN.

operators.name: num_special_ext_carlson_rf
operators.doc: Carlson's symmetric elliptic integral `R_F(x, y, z)`. Arguments must be finite and non-negative, with at most one zero; invalid arguments or failure of bounded duplication return NaN.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_c
operators.doc: The Coulomb normalising constant `C_l(η)` (DLMF 33.2.5), `C_l(η) = 2^l e^{-πη/2} |Γ(l + 1 + iη)| / Γ(2l + 2)`, evaluated in logarithmic form so that large `|η|` neither overflows nor underflows prematurely.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_f
operators.doc: The regular Coulomb function `F_l(η, ρ)` (DLMF 33.2.4).

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_f_prime
operators.doc: The derivative `dF_l/dρ` of the regular Coulomb function.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_fg
signatures: (Float, Int, Float) -> None | Some({ item0: Float, item1: Float, item2: Float, item3: Float })
operators.doc: The regular and irregular Coulomb functions and their derivatives.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_g
operators.doc: The irregular Coulomb function `G_l(η, ρ)`, normalised by `F' G - F G' = 1` (DLMF 33.2.6).

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_g_from_u
signatures: (Float, Int, Float) -> None | Some({ item0: Float, item1: Float })
operators.doc: The irregular Coulomb function `G_l(η, ρ)` and its derivative from the Tricomi function.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_g_prime
operators.doc: The derivative `dG_l/dρ` of the irregular Coulomb function.

operators.name: num_special_ext_coulomb_sigma
operators.doc: The Coulomb phase shift `σ_l(η) = arg Γ(l + 1 + iη)` (DLMF 33.2.10).

operators.name: num_special_ext_elliptic_e
operators.doc: Complete elliptic integral of the second kind `E(m)`, `m <= 1`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_elliptic_e_inc
operators.doc: Incomplete elliptic integral of the second kind `E(phi, m)`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_elliptic_f
operators.doc: Incomplete elliptic integral of the first kind `F(phi, m)`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_elliptic_k
operators.doc: Complete elliptic integral of the first kind `K(m)`, `m < 1`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_hyp1f1
operators.doc: Kummer confluent hypergeometric function `1F1(a; b; x)`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_hyp2f1
operators.doc: Gauss hypergeometric function `2F1(a, b; c; z)` for real arguments.

operators.name: num_special_ext_hyp2f1_complex
operators.doc: Gauss hypergeometric function `2F1(a, b; c; z)` for a complex argument and real parameters, on the principal branch (cut along `[1, inf)`; real `z > 1` gives the limit from the upper half plane).

operators.name: num_special_ext_jacobi_elliptic
signatures: (Float, Float) -> { item0: Float, item1: Float, item2: Float }
operators.doc: Jacobi elliptic functions `(sn, cn, dn)` of `u` with parameter `m = k^2` in `[0, 1]`; NaNs outside that range.

operators.name: num_special_ext_kelvin_bei
operators.doc: The Kelvin function `bei_ν(x) = Im J_ν(x e^(3πi/4))`; domain and accuracy as [`kelvin_ber`].

operators.name: num_special_ext_kelvin_ber
operators.doc: The Kelvin function `ber_ν(x) = Re J_ν(x e^(3πi/4))` for an integer order `ν <= 100` and `x >= 0`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_kelvin_kei
operators.doc: The Kelvin function `kei_ν(x)`, the imaginary part of `e^(-iπν/2) K_ν(x e^(iπ/4))`; domain and accuracy as [`kelvin_ker`].

operators.name: num_special_ext_kelvin_ker
operators.doc: The Kelvin function `ker_ν(x) + i kei_ν(x) = e^(-iπν/2) K_ν(x e^(iπ/4))` for an integer order `ν <= 100` and `x > 0`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_lerch
operators.doc: The Lerch transcendent `Φ(z, s, a) = Σ_{k=0}^∞ z^k / (k+a)^s` for real `s`, real `a > 0` and `z < 1` (the standard range).

operators.name: num_special_ext_polylog
operators.doc: The polylogarithm `Li_s(z)` for real `s` and real `z`.

operators.name: num_special_ext_polylog_complex
operators.doc: The polylogarithm `Li_s(z)` for complex `s` and `z`, on the principal branch (cut along `[1, ∞)`).

operators.name: num_special_ext_weber_e
operators.doc: The Weber function `E_ν(x) = (1/π) ∫_0^π sin(νθ - x sin θ) dθ` for real `ν` and `x`.

operators.name: num_special_generalized_laguerre
operators.doc: The generalised Laguerre polynomial `L_n^{(α)}(x)` by the three-term recurrence.

operators.name: num_special_hermite_h
operators.doc: Computes the (physicists') Hermite polynomial `H_n(x)`.

operators.name: num_special_hurwitz_zeta
operators.doc: Computes the Hurwitz zeta function ζ(s, q) for real s and q. Defined as Σ_{n=0}^∞ 1/(n+q)^s.

operators.name: num_special_incomplete_beta
operators.doc: Computes the incomplete beta function, B(x; a, b) = ∫₀ˣ t^(a-1) (1-t)^(b-1) dt.

operators.name: num_special_laguerre_l
operators.doc: Computes the Laguerre polynomial `L_n(x)`.

operators.name: num_special_lambert_w
operators.doc: The Lambert W function: `W(x) e^{W(x)} = x`.

operators.name: num_special_legendre_p
operators.doc: Computes the Legendre polynomial `P_n(x)` using recurrence relation.

operators.name: num_special_ln_beta_numerical
operators.doc: Computes the natural logarithm of the beta function, ln(B(a, b)).

operators.name: num_special_lower_incomplete_gamma
operators.doc: Computes the lower incomplete gamma function, γ(s, x) = ∫₀ˣ t^(s-1) e^(-t) dt.

operators.name: num_special_polygamma_numerical
operators.doc: Computes the polygamma function ψ^(n)(z) for real z > 0 and integer n >= 0. The 0-th polygamma is the digamma function.

operators.name: num_special_regularized_beta
operators.doc: Computes the regularized incomplete beta function, `I_x(a`, b) = B(x; a, b) / B(a, b). Uses continued fraction expansion for better convergence.

operators.name: num_special_regularized_lower_gamma
operators.doc: The regularised lower incomplete gamma function `P(s, x)`, accurate in both tails; `P(0, x) = 1` for `x > 0` and NaN for `s < 0` or `x < 0`.

operators.name: num_special_regularized_upper_gamma
operators.doc: The regularised upper incomplete gamma function `Q(s, x) = 1 - P(s, x)`, computed directly so that `Q` of order `1e-300` keeps its digits.

operators.name: num_special_upper_incomplete_gamma
operators.doc: The upper incomplete gamma function `Gamma(s, x)`, computed from the complementary tail (no cancellation against `Gamma(s)`); defined for every real `s` when `x > 0` (`s <= 0` through the recurrence and `E1`).

operators.name: num_spectral_radius
operators.doc: Largest absolute eigenvalue.

operators.name: num_spline_clamped
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Float[_], Float[_]) -> Float[_]
operators.doc: Clamped cubic spline with explicit endpoint derivatives, each in ordinate per abscissa units.

operators.name: num_spline_not_a_knot
operators.doc: Not-a-knot cubic spline with independent coordinate and ordinate dimensions.

operators.name: num_standard_error
operators.doc: Standard error of the mean.

operators.name: num_stats_chi_squared_test
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float>, Tensor<1, Float>) -> { item0: Float, item1: Float }
operators.doc: Performs a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test. Tests if observed frequencies match expected frequencies. Returns (chi-squared statistic, p-value).

operators.name: num_stats_ext_anova_one_way
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: One-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) across `k >= 2` groups.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_chi_squared_goodness_of_fit
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float>, Tensor<1, Float>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Pearson's chi-squared goodness-of-fit test.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_chi_squared_independence
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Pearson's chi-squared test of independence on a row-major `rows × cols` contingency table.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_kde
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, None | Some(Float[_])) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>
operators.doc: Gaussian Kernel Density Estimation evaluated at `points`.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_kendall
operators.doc: Kendall's tau-b rank correlation coefficient (adjusted for ties).

operators.name: num_stats_ext_ks_test_two_sample
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov test comparing two empirical distributions.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_lasso
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Bool, Int, Float[_]) -> { coefficients: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, intercept: Float[_], r_squared: Float, residuals: Tensor<1, Float[_]> }
operators.doc: Lasso (L1-regularized) linear regression via coordinate descent, minimizing `(1 / (2n)) ||y - Xβ||₂² + alpha ||β||₁`.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_logistic_regression
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float>, Bool, Int, Float) -> { coefficients: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, intercept: Float, log_likelihood: Float, iterations: Int }
operators.doc: Binary logistic regression via Newton-Raphson (IRLS).

operators.name: num_stats_ext_mann_whitney_u
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Two-sided Mann–Whitney U test (Wilcoxon rank-sum test) with tie-corrected normal approximation.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_ols
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Bool) -> { coefficients: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, intercept: Float[_], r_squared: Float, residuals: Tensor<1, Float[_]> }
operators.doc: Ordinary Least Squares linear regression using SVD least-squares.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_pca
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, None | Some(Int)) -> { mean: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, components: Tensor<1, Float>, explained_variance: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, explained_variance_ratio: Tensor<1, Float>, transformed: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, n_components: Int }
operators.doc: Principal Component Analysis via SVD of the mean-centered data matrix.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_ridge
signatures: (Int, Int, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_], Bool) -> { coefficients: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, intercept: Float[_], r_squared: Float, residuals: Tensor<1, Float[_]> }
operators.doc: Ridge (L2-regularized) linear regression minimizing `||y - Xβ||₂² + alpha ||β||₂²`.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_spearman
operators.doc: Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (with average ranks for ties).

operators.name: num_stats_ext_t_test_one_sample
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float[_]) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: One-sample Student's t-test against population mean `mu0`.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_t_test_paired
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Paired-samples t-test on `left - right`.

operators.name: num_stats_ext_t_test_two_sample
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Bool) -> { statistic: Float, p_value: Float, df: None | Some(Float) }
operators.doc: Two-sample t-test (Student's pooled-variance when `equal_var` is `true`, Welch's unequal-variance otherwise).

operators.name: num_stats_mode
operators.doc: Finds the mode (most frequent value) of a slice of data. For continuous data, rounds to a specified number of decimal places. Returns None if no mode exists (all values unique or empty).

operators.name: num_stats_one_way_anova
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, values: Tensor<1, Float[_]> }) -> { item0: Float, item1: Float }
operators.doc: One-way ANOVA on independently sized groups encoded as CSR offsets/values. Input groups have one shared measurement unit; F statistic and p-value are dimensionless.

operators.name: num_stats_percentile
operators.doc: Measured percentile with a private mutable copy of the input. The native sorting/selection routine cannot mutate the caller's tensor; percentile p is dimensionless in 0 through 100.

operators.name: num_stats_simple_linear_regression
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { item0: Float[_], item1: Float[_] }
operators.doc: Simple native linear regression on separately measured equal-length predictor and response vectors; slope is response/predictor and intercept is response.

operators.name: num_stats_two_sample_t_test
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { item0: Float, item1: Float }
operators.doc: Performs an independent two-sample t-test to determine if two samples have different means.

operators.name: num_stats_variance_with_type
operators.doc: Computes the variance of a slice of data with a specified variance type (Population or Sample).

operators.name: num_stats_welch_t_test
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { item0: Float, item1: Float }
operators.doc: Performs Welch's t-test for two samples with potentially unequal variances. Returns (t-statistic, p-value).

operators.name: num_std_dev
operators.doc: Sample standard deviation.

operators.name: num_svd
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>) -> { u: Tensor<2, Float>, s: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, v: Tensor<2, Float> }
operators.doc: Thin SVD A = U diag(s) V^T; returns u, s and v.

operators.name: num_tanh_sinh
signatures: (Float[_], Float[_], Float[_], Int, Int, (Float[_]) -> Float[_]) -> { value: Float[_], evaluations: Int, error: Float[_], converged: Bool }
operators.doc: Dimension-aware serial quadrature with a strict callback evaluation budget. Fixed rules: a,b,order,max_evaluations,callback. Romberg/tanh-sinh: a,b,tolerance,max_levels,max_evaluations,callback. Semi-infinite rules: finite_bound,tolerance,max_evaluations,callback; left-infinite integrates (-infinity,bound], right-infinite [bound,infinity). Full infinite rule: tolerance,max_evaluations,callback. Adaptive results include value,error,evaluations,converged; fixed rules report value,evaluations. Callback failures propagate unchanged.

operators.name: num_topology_betti_number
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }, Int) -> Int
operators.doc: The homology Betti number `b_k` of a closed complex: `dim ker d_k - rank d_{k+1}`.

operators.name: num_topology_betti_numbers_at_radius
operators.doc: The Betti numbers `b_0 ..= b_max_dim` of the Vietoris-Rips complex at radius `epsilon`.

operators.name: num_topology_boundary_matrix
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }, { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> Tensor<2, Int>
operators.doc: The boundary matrix of `cols` (k-simplices) onto `rows` ((k-1)-simplices); `rows.len()` rows and `cols.len()` columns.

operators.name: num_topology_close_complex
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The simplices of `simplices` closed under faces, without duplicates, sorted by dimension and then lexicographically. Each simplex is sorted and deduplicated first; empty simplices are dropped.

operators.name: num_topology_cohomology_betti_number
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }, Int) -> Int
operators.doc: The cohomology Betti number `b^k`, from the ranks of the coboundary matrices (the transposes of the boundary matrices).

operators.name: num_topology_complex_dimension
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> None | Some(Int)
operators.doc: The dimension of a closed complex (`None` if empty).

operators.name: num_topology_compute_persistence
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>, Float[_], Int, Int) -> { dimensions: Tensor<1, Int>, offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, births: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, deaths: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, essential: Tensor<1, Bool> }
operators.doc: The persistence diagrams of a point cloud, `max_dim` and below.

operators.name: num_topology_euclidean_distance
operators.doc: The Euclidean distance between two points.

operators.name: num_topology_euler_characteristic
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> Int
operators.doc: The Euler characteristic `sum (-1)^k #k-simplices`.

operators.name: num_topology_find_connected_components
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The connected components of a graph given by adjacency lists (BFS).

operators.name: num_topology_grid_complex
signatures: (Int, Int) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The triangulated `width x height` grid: two triangles per cell.

operators.name: num_topology_int_matmul
operators.doc: The product of two integer matrices (`a` is `r x m`, `b` is `m x c`).

operators.name: num_topology_integer_rank
operators.doc: The rank of an integer matrix, computed exactly over the rationals by Gaussian elimination.

operators.name: num_topology_persistent_homology
signatures: ({ radii: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, simplices: { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> } }, Int) -> { dimensions: Tensor<1, Int>, offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, births: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, deaths: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, essential: Tensor<1, Bool> }
operators.doc: Exact persistent homology over `Z/2` of a filtered simplicial complex.

operators.name: num_topology_persistent_homology_rips
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>, Float[_], Int, Int) -> { dimensions: Tensor<1, Int>, offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, births: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, deaths: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, essential: Tensor<1, Bool> }
operators.doc: Exact Vietoris-Rips persistent homology of a point cloud.

operators.name: num_topology_simplex_boundary
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>) -> { coefficients: Tensor<1, Int>, simplices: { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> } }
operators.doc: The boundary of an oriented simplex: `(sign, face)` pairs, with sign `(-1)^i` for the face omitting vertex `i`. Empty for a vertex.

operators.name: num_topology_simplices_of_dim
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }, Int) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The `k`-simplices of a complex, in order.

operators.name: num_topology_torus_complex
signatures: (Int, Int) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The triangulated torus obtained from an `m x n` grid by identifying opposite edges (a valid simplicial complex for `m, n >= 3`).

operators.name: num_topology_transpose
operators.doc: The transpose of an integer matrix with `cols` columns.

operators.name: num_topology_verify_boundary_property
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> Bool
operators.doc: Whether `d_k d_{k+1} = 0` for every `k`.

operators.name: num_topology_verify_coboundary_property
signatures: ({ offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }) -> Bool
operators.doc: Whether the coboundaries satisfy `d^{k+1} d^k = 0` for every `k`.

operators.name: num_topology_vietoris_rips_complex
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>, Float[_], Int) -> { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: The Vietoris-Rips complex of a point cloud.

operators.name: num_topology_vietoris_rips_filtration
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>, Float[_], Int) -> { radii: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, complex_offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, simplices: { offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, indices: Tensor<1, Int> } }
operators.doc: The Vietoris-Rips filtration restricted to its 1-skeleton: for each of `steps + 1` radii `max_epsilon * s / steps` the vertices and the edges no longer than the radius.

operators.name: num_transforms_irfft
operators.doc: Inverts [`rfft`]: reconstructs the real signal of length `n` from its `n/2 + 1` non-redundant bins, with the `1/n` normalisation of [`ifft`].

operators.name: num_transforms_rfft
operators.doc: Computes the real-input FFT: the `n/2 + 1` non-redundant bins of the DFT of a real sequence.

operators.name: num_transpose
operators.doc: Transpose a dense matrix.

operators.name: num_triangle_boundary_vertices
operators.doc: Actual triangular FEM with explicit Length/Time/field references, variable compiled diffusion/reaction/source/Dirichlet data, original CG/P1/P2/refinement algorithms and bounded native storage/work. Callback arguments and outputs are coherent physical quantities.

operators.name: num_triangle_compacted
operators.doc: Actual triangular FEM with explicit Length/Time/field references, variable compiled diffusion/reaction/source/Dirichlet data, original CG/P1/P2/refinement algorithms and bounded native storage/work. Callback arguments and outputs are coherent physical quantities.

operators.name: num_triangle_data

operators.name: num_trust_region_scaled
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, { coordinate_scale: Float[_], value_scale: Float[_], tolerance: Float, max_iterations: Int, max_evaluations: Int }, (Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Float[_], (Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>) -> { x: Tensor<1, Float[_]>, iterations: Int, evaluations: Int, converged: Bool, value: Float[_] }
operators.doc: Measured nonlinear problem with explicit coordinate_scale and value_scale, dimensionless tolerance, max_iterations and max_evaluations controls. Solves in normalized coordinates/residuals. Arguments: initial, controls, optional lower/upper, objective/residual, optional gradient. Gradient units are objective/coordinate. Homogeneous coordinate and residual vectors; callback failures propagate and budgets are shared.

operators.name: num_tt_svd
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Int>, Float, Int) -> { cores: Tensor<1, Tensor<3, Float>>, shape: Tensor<1, Int>, scale: Float[_], error: Float[_], tolerance_met: Bool }
operators.doc: Tensor-train SVD of row-major data; rank cap must be positive. Returns dimensionless normalized cores, shape, scale, Frobenius truncation error and tolerance status; reconstruction multiplies the core contraction by scale.

operators.name: num_variance
operators.doc: Population variance; zero for an empty sample.

operators.name: num_vector_add
operators.doc: Element-wise sum of equal-length vectors.

operators.name: num_vector_is_orthogonal
operators.doc: Checks if two vectors are orthogonal.

operators.name: num_vector_is_parallel
operators.doc: Checks if two vectors are parallel.

operators.name: num_vector_lerp
signatures: (Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Tensor<1, Float[_]>, Float) -> Tensor<1, Float[_]>
operators.doc: Linearly interpolates between two vectors.

operators.name: num_vector_sub
operators.doc: Element-wise difference of equal-length vectors.

operators.name: num_voronoi_2d
signatures: (Tensor<2, Float[_]>) -> { vertices: Tensor<2, Float[_]>, edges: Tensor<2, Int>, ray_vertices: Tensor<1, Int>, ray_directions: Tensor<2, Float>, cell_offsets: Tensor<1, Int>, cell_indices: Tensor<1, Int> }
operators.doc: Planar Voronoi diagram dual to Delaunay, with measured vertices and dimensionless topology/unit ray directions. Input requires 3..=1024 finite nondegenerate sites. Cells are CSR-style cell_offsets/cell_indices; unbounded cells are described by ray_vertices/ray_directions rather than fabricated finite polygons.

operators.name: num_wavelets_frft
operators.doc: Discrete fractional Fourier transform of order `a` of the complex signal `x`.

operators.name: num_wavelets_frft_matrix
operators.doc: The `n x n` matrix of the discrete fractional Fourier transform of order `a` (row-major).

operators.name: num_z_scores
operators.doc: Sample z scores.

operators.name: ode_asymptotic
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: `ode_asymptotic(ode, y, x0, c, order, point)`: evaluates a truncated formal asymptotic expansion of `ode` at `point` around singular point `x0`.
examples: ode_asymptotic(diff(diff(y(x), x), x) - x*y(x), y(x), oo, 60, 5, 0)

operators.name: ode_borel
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `ode_borel(ode, y, x0, c, order, point)`: evaluates the Borel-Pade resummation of a divergent formal asymptotic solution of `ode` at `point`.
examples: ode_borel(diff(diff(y(x), x), x) - x*y(x), y(x), oo, 90, 5, 0)

operators.name: ode_classify
operators.doc: `ode_classify(ode, y)`: classifies an ordinary differential equation `ode` for dependent function `y`, returning a list of applicable solver classes.

operators.name: ode_darboux
operators.doc: `ode_darboux(dx, dy, x, y, [max_deg])`: finds Darboux polynomials and cofactors `[P, k]` for planar autonomous system `x' = dx, y' = dy`.

operators.name: ode_etdrk4
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Tensor<2, Int>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: `ode_etdrk4(L, f, vars, t, u0, t0, t1, steps)`: `u(t1)` for `u' = L u + f(t, u)` by fourth-order exponential time differencing.
examples: ode_etdrk4(list(list(0, 1), list(-1, 0)), list(-0.5*u1, -0.5*u2), list(u1, u2), t, list(1, 0), 0, 1, 50)

operators.name: ode_fourier
operators.doc: `ode_fourier(ode, y)`: solves linear constant-coefficient `ode` for `y` using Fourier transform.

operators.name: ode_frobenius
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> { _0: Dyn<term>, _1: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _2: Dyn<term> }
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int) -> { _0: Dyn<term>, _1: Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>, _2: Dyn<term> }
operators.doc: `ode_frobenius(ode, y, x0, order)`: applies the Frobenius method around regular singular point `x0`, returning solution, indicial roots, and recurrence.
examples: ode_frobenius(x^4*diff(diff(y(x), x), x) + 2*x^3*diff(y(x), x) - y(x), y(x), 0, 5)
ode_frobenius(diff(diff(y(x), x), x) - x*y(x), y(x), oo, 24)
ode_frobenius(x^2*diff(diff(y(x), x), x) - (x^2 + 1/4)*y(x) + x*diff(y(x), x), y(x), oo, 4)

operators.name: ode_imex
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int, Int, Int, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: `ode_imex(f_ex, f_im, vars, t, y0, t0, t1, steps, scheme)`: `y(t1)` for `y' = f_ex + f_im` with explicit `f_ex` and stiff implicit `f_im` using `euler`, `ars222`, or `ars343`.

operators.name: ode_jacobi_last_multiplier
operators.doc: `ode_jacobi_last_multiplier(dx, dy, x, y, [max_deg])`: computes a Jacobi last multiplier (integrating factor) for planar system `x' = dx, y' = dy`.

operators.name: ode_series
operators.doc: `ode_series(ode, y, x0, order)`: computes a power-series solution `y(x) = ...` of `ode` about `x0` up to `order`.

operators.name: ode_solve
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int, Int, Float, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Float>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int, Float, Float, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: `ode_solve(rhs, vars, t, y0, t0, t1, tol, method)`: `y(t1)` for `y' = rhs(t, y)` with `y(t0) = y0` using `dopri5`, `rosenbrock23`, `radau5`, `bdf`, `sdirk3`, or `exprb32`.
examples: ode_solve(list(y2, -y1), list(y1, y2), t, list(1, 0), 0, 1.5, 0.0000000001, dopri5)

operators.name: ode_symmetries
operators.doc: `ode_symmetries(ode, y)`: finds Lie point symmetry generators `[xi, eta]` admitted by `ode` for dependent function `y`.

operators.name: ode_symplectic
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int, Float, Int, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<2, Float>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int, Int, Int, Dyn<term>) -> Tensor<2, Float>
operators.doc: `ode_symplectic(accel, vars, q0, p0, t0, t1, steps, method)`: `list(q, p)` at `t1` for `q' = p`, `p' = accel(q)` using `verlet`, `yoshida4`, `yoshida6`, or `yoshida8`.
examples: ode_symplectic(list(-q1, -4*q2), list(q1, q2), list(1, 0), list(0, 1), 0, 1, 400, yoshida6)

operators.name: odeint
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: `odeint(f, y, x, x0, y0, x1)`: numerically integrates `dy/dx = f(x, y)` from `(x0, y0)` to `x1`.

operators.name: omega
operators.doc: `omega(n)`: number of distinct prime factors of `n`.

operators.name: one_parameter_subgroup
operators.doc: `one_parameter_subgroup(A, t)`: one-parameter subgroup `exp_map(t * A)` generated by matrix `A`.

operators.name: oo
operators.doc: `oo`: positive real infinity (`+infinity`).

operators.name: op_add
operators.doc: `op_add(A, B, ...)`: sum `A + B + ...` of linear operators.

operators.name: op_apply
operators.doc: `op_apply(A, f)`: apply linear operator `A` to function or vector `f`.

operators.name: op_commutator
operators.doc: `op_commutator(A, B)`: commutator `[A, B] = A B - B A` of operators `A` and `B`.

operators.name: op_compose
operators.doc: `op_compose(A, B, ...)`: composition `A o B o ...` of linear operators (rightmost acts first).

operators.name: op_d
operators.doc: `op_d(x)`: differential operator `f -> d/dx(f)`.

operators.name: op_identity
operators.doc: `op_identity()`: identity linear operator `f -> f`.

operators.name: op_int
operators.doc: `op_int(a, x)`: Volterra integration operator `f -> int_a^x f(t) dt`.

operators.name: op_laplacian
operators.doc: `op_laplacian(vars)`: Laplacian differential operator `sum_i d^2 / dx_i^2` over `vars`.

operators.name: op_mul
operators.doc: `op_mul(g)`: linear multiplication operator `f -> g * f`.

operators.name: op_power
operators.doc: `op_power(A, n)`: `n`-fold composition `A^n` of linear operator `A`.

operators.name: op_scale
operators.doc: `op_scale(c, A)`: linear operator `A` scaled by `c`.

operators.name: operator_adjoint
operators.doc: `operator_adjoint(A)`: formal `L^2` adjoint `A*` of differential/multiplication operator `A`.

operators.name: or
operators.doc: `or(p1, p2, ...)`: variadic logical disjunction, true when at least one operand is true.

operators.name: orbit_density
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
operators.doc: Computes an `nx` by `ny` 2D occupancy histogram of `points` over `[xmin, xmax] × [ymin, ymax]`.

operators.name: orbit_entropy
operators.doc: Computes the Shannon entropy of a 2D occupancy histogram `density`.

operators.name: orthogonal_coefficients
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `orthogonal_coefficients(f, basis, x, a, b)`: Fourier coefficients `<e_i, f> / <e_i, e_i>` of `f` in orthogonal `basis`.

operators.name: orthogonalize
operators.doc: `orthogonalize(vecs)`: Gram-Schmidt orthogonal basis from a list of vectors.

operators.name: orthographic
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Int, Int, Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: Constructs a 4x4 OpenGL-style orthographic projection matrix from `(left, right, bottom, top, near, far)`.

operators.name: orthonormalize
operators.doc: `orthonormalize(vecs)`: Gram-Schmidt orthonormal basis from a list of vectors.

operators.name: oscillatory_integral
signatures: (Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Int, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: `oscillatory_integral(f, g, x, a, b, w, n)`: `list(re, im)` of `int_a^b f(x) exp(i w g(x)) dx` by Levin collocation at `n` Chebyshev points.

operators.name: outer
operators.doc: `outer(u, v)`: outer product matrix `u v^T` of vectors `u` and `v`.

operators.name: pareto
operators.doc: `pareto(scale, shape)`: Pareto distribution with minimum scale `scale` and shape parameter `shape`.

operators.name: partition_function
operators.doc: `partition_function(energies, T)`: canonical partition function `sum_i exp(-E_i / (k_B T))` over energy levels `energies`.

operators.name: partition_list
operators.doc: `partition_list(n)`: list of all integer partitions of `n` in non-increasing part order.

operators.name: partitions
operators.doc: `partitions(n)`: integer partition function `p(n)`, counting ways to write `n` as a sum of positive integers.

operators.name: partitions_distinct
operators.doc: `partitions_distinct(n)`: number of integer partitions of `n` into distinct positive parts.

operators.name: partitions_k
operators.doc: `partitions_k(n, k)`: number of integer partitions of `n` into exactly `k` positive parts.

operators.name: partitions_max
operators.doc: `partitions_max(n, k)`: number of integer partitions of `n` whose parts are at most `k`.

operators.name: path
operators.doc: `path(g, t, t0, t1)`: parameterized contour `g(t)` as `t` runs from `t0` to `t1`.

operators.name: pauli_matrices
operators.doc: `pauli_matrices`: list of the three 2x2 Pauli matrices `list(pauli_x, pauli_y, pauli_z)`.

operators.name: pauli_x
operators.doc: `pauli_x`: 2x2 Pauli matrix `sigma_x = [[0, 1], [1, 0]]`.

operators.name: pauli_y
operators.doc: `pauli_y`: 2x2 Pauli matrix `sigma_y = [[0, -i], [i, 0]]`.

operators.name: pauli_z
operators.doc: `pauli_z`: 2x2 Pauli matrix `sigma_z = [[1, 0], [0, -1]]`.

operators.name: pde_classify
operators.doc: `pde_classify(pde, u)`: classifies `pde` for unknown `u` by type (elliptic, parabolic, hyperbolic), order, dimension, and linearity.
examples: pde_classify(diff(u(x, t), t) - k*diff(diff(u(x, t), x), x), u(x, t))

operators.name: pde_complete_integral
operators.doc: `pde_complete_integral(pde, u)`: complete integral `u(x, y) = ...` of a first-order PDE via Charpit's method.

operators.name: pde_crum_kdv
operators.doc: `pde_crum_kdv(u, psis)`: iterated Crum-Darboux transformation of KdV seed `u` using eigenfunctions `psis`.

operators.name: pde_darboux_kdv
operators.doc: `pde_darboux_kdv(u, psi)`: single Darboux-Bäcklund transformation `u - 2 d^2/dx^2 ln(psi)` for KdV.

operators.name: pde_greens_ball
operators.doc: `pde_greens_ball(x, s)`: Dirichlet Green's function for the Laplacian on a unit/radius ball.

operators.name: pde_greens_ball_neumann
operators.doc: `pde_greens_ball_neumann(x, s)`: zero-mean Neumann Green's function for the Laplacian on a ball.

operators.name: pde_greens_ball_robin
operators.doc: `pde_greens_ball_robin(x, s)`: interior Robin Green's function for the Laplacian on a ball.

operators.name: pde_greens_exterior_robin
operators.doc: `pde_greens_exterior_robin(x, s, R)`: exterior Robin Green's function for the Laplacian outside a ball of radius `R`.

operators.name: pde_greens_function
operators.doc: `pde_greens_function(op, domain, ...)`: symbolic Green's function for differential operator `op` on `domain`.

operators.name: pde_greens_robin
operators.doc: `pde_greens_robin(x, s)`: Robin boundary Green's function for the Laplacian on a half-space.

operators.name: pde_hodograph
operators.doc: `pde_hodograph(sys, vars)`: derives the linear hodograph PDE `(lambda - mu) t_rs + lambda_r t_s - mu_s t_r = 0` for a 2x2 hyperbolic system.

operators.name: pde_hodograph_riemann
operators.doc: `pde_hodograph_riemann(gamma)`: Riemann function for the Euler-Poisson-Darboux hodograph equation.

operators.name: pde_hodograph_solution
operators.doc: `pde_hodograph_solution(F, G, ...)`: hodograph-transformed parametric solution `list(x(r, s), t(r, s))` in Riemann invariants.

operators.name: pde_kdv_reflectionless
operators.doc: `pde_kdv_reflectionless(params, x_t)`: KdV time evolution of the reflectionless potential `-N(N+1) kappa^2 sech^2(kappa x)`.

operators.name: pde_kdv_scattering
operators.doc: `pde_kdv_scattering(data, x, t)`: numeric KdV inverse-scattering (Gelfand-Levitan-Marchenko) evaluation at `(x, t)`.

operators.name: pde_kdv_soliton
operators.doc: `pde_kdv_soliton(kappas, x_t)`: N-soliton Hirota tau-function solution `-2 d^2/dx^2 ln det(I + A)` of the KdV equation.

operators.name: pde_nls_soliton
operators.doc: `pde_nls_soliton(params)`: bright soliton solution of the focusing nonlinear Schrodinger equation.

operators.name: pde_order
operators.doc: `pde_order(pde, u)`: highest partial-derivative order of `u` appearing in `pde`.

operators.name: pde_poisson_integral
operators.doc: `pde_poisson_integral(g, x, domain)`: Poisson integral representation of the harmonic function with boundary data `g` on `domain`.

operators.name: pde_riemann_shallow_water
signatures: (Int, Int, Float, Int, Float) -> { _0: Float, _1: Float, _2: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, _3: Tensor<1, Dyn<term>> }
operators.doc: `pde_riemann_shallow_water(hL, uL, hR, uR, g)`: exact Riemann problem solution `list(h*, u*, left_wave, right_wave)` for 1D shallow-water equations.

operators.name: pde_riemann_shallow_water_at
signatures: (Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real) -> Real
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Int, Int, Int, Float, Int, Float) -> Float
operators.doc: `pde_riemann_shallow_water_at(hL, uL, hR, uR, g, xi)`: self-similar shallow-water depth `h(x/t = xi)` from the Riemann solver.

operators.name: pde_riemann_shallow_water_velocity
signatures: (Real, Real, Real, Real, Real, Real) -> Real
(Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>, Dyn<term>) -> Dyn<term>
(Int, Int, Int, Float, Int, Float) -> Float
operators.doc: `pde_riemann_shallow_water_velocity(hL, uL, hR, uR, g, xi)`: self-similar shallow-water velocity `u(x/t = xi)` from the Riemann solver.

operators.name: pde_separate
operators.doc: `pde_separate(pde, u)`: separated-variables ansatz and decoupled ODEs for `pde` and unknown `u`.

operators.name: pde_similarity
operators.doc: `pde_similarity(pde, u, generator)`: similarity reduction `list(u = g F(z), ODE)` along a scaling/symmetry `generator`.

operators.name: pde_sine_gordon_soliton
operators.doc: `pde_sine_gordon_soliton(params, x_t)`: kink/antikink or breather soliton solution of the sine-Gordon equation.

operators.name: pde_symmetries
operators.doc: `pde_symmetries(pde, u)`: Lie point symmetry infinitesimal generators of `pde` for unknown `u`.
examples: pde_symmetries(diff(u(x, t), t) = diff(diff(u(x, t), x), x), u(x, t))

operators.name: pde_traveling_wave
operators.doc: `pde_traveling_wave(pde, u, c)`: traveling-wave ansatz `u = F(x - c t)` and reduced ODE for speed `c`.

operators.name: pdf
operators.doc: `pdf(d, x)`: probability density function (or probability mass function) of distribution `d` at point `x`.

operators.name: pdsolve
signatures: () -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>> with 0... x Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `pdsolve(pde, u, ...)`: general symbolic/numeric PDE solver for unknown `u` with optional boundary/initial conditions.
examples: pdsolve(list(diff(u(x, t), t) + diff(v(x, t), x) = 0, diff(u(x, t), x) + diff(v(x, t), t) = 0), list(u(x, t), v(x, t)))
pdsolve(list(diff(u(x, t), t) + diff(u(x, t), x) + diff(v(x, t), x) = 0, diff(v(x, t), t) + diff(v(x, t), x) = cos(x)), list(u(x, t), v(x, t)), list(u(x, 0) = 0, v(x, 0) = 0))

operators.name: pell
operators.doc: `pell(D)`: fundamental solution `list(x, y)` to Pell's equation `x^2 - D*y^2 = 1` for non-square `D > 0`.

operators.name: percentile
operators.doc: `percentile(xs, p)`: `p`-th percentile (`quantile(xs, p / 100)`) of list `xs`.

operators.name: perfect_power
operators.doc: `perfect_power(n)`: `list(b, e)` with maximal `e >= 1` such that `b^e = n` (for `n >= 2`).

operators.name: period
operators.doc: `period(sequence)`: minimal positive period of a repeating list `sequence`.

operators.name: perm_compose
operators.doc: Composes two permutations `p` and `q` (1-based image lists) as `(p * q)(i) = p(q(i))`.

operators.name: perm_cycles
operators.doc: Decomposes permutation `p` into its non-trivial disjoint cycles.

operators.name: perm_group_are_conjugate
operators.doc: Returns `true` if permutations `x` and `y` are conjugate in `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_base
operators.doc: Returns a Schreier-Sims base (points whose pointwise stabilizer is trivial) for the group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_basic_orbits
operators.doc: Returns the lengths of the basic orbits along the stabilizer chain (whose product equals the group order).

operators.name: perm_group_blocks
operators.doc: Computes the finest block system of `<gens>` placing points `a` and `b` in the same block.

operators.name: perm_group_center
operators.doc: Returns generators of the center `Z(G)` of the permutation group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_centralizer
operators.doc: Returns generators of the centralizer of permutation `x` in the permutation group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_class_count
operators.doc: Returns the number of conjugacy classes of `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_composition_factors
operators.doc: Returns the prime orders `p` of the cyclic composition factors `C_p` of a solvable permutation group `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_conjugacy_classes
operators.doc: Returns the conjugacy classes of `<gens>` as `list(list(representative, size), ...)` ordered by element order.

operators.name: perm_group_conjugating_element
operators.doc: Finds a permutation `g` in `<gens>` such that `g * x * g^(-1) = y`, or returns `false` if none exists.

operators.name: perm_group_contains
operators.doc: Tests whether permutation `p` belongs to the permutation group generated by `gens` by sifting through the stabilizer chain.

operators.name: perm_group_derived_series
operators.doc: Computes the orders of the derived series `G = G_0 > G_1 > ...` of the group generated by `gens`, stopping at the perfect core.

operators.name: perm_group_derived_subgroup
operators.doc: Returns generators of the commutator (derived) subgroup `G'` of the group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_elements
operators.doc: Enumerates all elements of the permutation group generated by `gens` (for group orders up to 5040).

operators.name: perm_group_exponent
operators.doc: Computes the group exponent (LCM of all element orders) of `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_intersection
operators.doc: Returns generators of the intersection `<gens> ∩ <hgens>` of two permutation groups.

operators.name: perm_group_is_abelian
operators.doc: Returns `true` if the permutation group generated by `gens` is abelian.

operators.name: perm_group_is_nilpotent
operators.doc: Returns `true` if the permutation group generated by `gens` is nilpotent.

operators.name: perm_group_is_normal
operators.doc: Returns `true` if `<hgens>` is a normal subgroup of `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_is_primitive
operators.doc: Returns `true` if `<gens>` acts primitively (transitively with no non-trivial block system).

operators.name: perm_group_is_solvable
operators.doc: Returns `true` if the permutation group generated by `gens` is solvable.

operators.name: perm_group_is_transitive
operators.doc: Returns `true` if the permutation group generated by `gens` acts transitively on `1..n`.

operators.name: perm_group_lower_central_series
operators.doc: Computes the orders of the lower central series `G = gamma_1 > gamma_2 > ...` of the group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_minimal_block_systems
operators.doc: Enumerates all minimal non-trivial block systems of `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_normal_closure
operators.doc: Returns generators of the normal closure of `<xs>` in `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_normalizer
operators.doc: Returns generators of the normalizer of `<hgens>` in `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_orbits
operators.doc: Returns the orbits of the permutation group generated by `gens` on `1..n`.

operators.name: perm_group_order
operators.doc: Computes the exact order of the permutation group generated by `gens` using the Schreier-Sims algorithm.

operators.name: perm_group_random_element
operators.doc: Draws a deterministic uniformly random element from `<gens>` using integer `seed`.

operators.name: perm_group_set_stabilizer
operators.doc: Returns generators of the setwise stabilizer of `points` in `<gens>`.

operators.name: perm_group_stabilizer_order
operators.doc: Computes the order of the point stabilizer of `i` in the permutation group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_strong_generators
operators.doc: Returns a strong generating set relative to the Schreier-Sims base for the group generated by `gens`.

operators.name: perm_group_sylow
operators.doc: Returns generators of a Sylow `p`-subgroup of `<gens>` for prime `p`.

operators.name: perm_inverse
operators.doc: Computes the inverse permutation `p^(-1)` of a 1-based permutation list `p`.

operators.name: perm_order
operators.doc: Computes the order (LCM of cycle lengths) of permutation `p`.

operators.name: perm_sign
operators.doc: Computes the sign (`1` for even, `-1` for odd) of permutation `p`.

operators.name: permutation_order
operators.doc: `permutation_order(perm)`: group order (LCM of disjoint cycle lengths) of permutation `perm`.

operators.name: permutation_rank
operators.doc: `permutation_rank(perm)`: 0-based lexicographic rank (Lehmer code) of permutation `perm` of `1..=n`.

operators.name: permutation_sign
operators.doc: `permutation_sign(perm)`: parity sign (`1` for even, `-1` for odd) of permutation `perm`.

operators.name: permutation_unrank
operators.doc: `permutation_unrank(n, rank)`: permutation of `1..=n` at 0-based lexicographic `rank`.

operators.name: permutations
operators.doc: `permutations(n, k)`: number of `k`-permutations of `n` items, `n! / (n - k)!`.

operators.name: persistence
signatures: (Tensor<2, Int>, Float, Int, Int) -> Tensor<1, Tensor<2, Float>>
operators.doc: Computes persistence intervals `list(birth, death)` per dimension up to `max_dim` by tracking Betti numbers over `steps + 1` radii up to `max_eps`.

operators.name: persistent_homology
operators.doc: Computes persistent homology barcodes over `Z/2` for a filtered complex up to `max_dim`, returning `list(birth, death)` pairs per dimension.

operators.name: perspective
operators.doc: Constructs a 4x4 OpenGL-style perspective projection matrix from `(fovy, aspect, near, far)`.

operators.name: pgcd
operators.doc: `pgcd(p, q, var)`: computes the polynomial greatest common divisor of `p` and `q` in `var`.

operators.name: pi
operators.doc: `pi`: Archimedes' constant, the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

operators.name: pinv
operators.doc: `pinv(A)`: Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse `A^+` of matrix `A`.

operators.name: planck_law
operators.doc: `planck_law(nu, T)`: Planck blackbody spectral radiance at frequency `nu` and temperature `T`.

operators.name: plasma_frequency
operators.doc: `plasma_frequency(n, e, eps, m)`: plasma angular frequency `sqrt(n e^2 / (eps m))`.

operators.name: point_charge_potential
operators.doc: `point_charge_potential(q, r)`: electrostatic potential `q / (4 pi epsilon_0 r)` of a point charge.

operators.name: point_group
operators.doc: Constructs the point group named by Schoenflies symbol `name` (e.g. `C2v`, `D4h`, `Td`, `Oh`, `Ih`) as a `group` term of 3x3 orthogonal matrices.

operators.name: point_group_character_table
operators.doc: Returns the exact character table of point group `name` as rows of class values.

operators.name: point_group_class_sizes
operators.doc: Returns the sizes of the conjugacy classes of point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_classes
operators.doc: Returns the conjugacy class labels (e.g. `E`, `8C3`, `3C2`) of point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_crystal_system
operators.doc: Returns the crystal system of crystallographic point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_decompose
operators.doc: Decomposes class function `chi` of point group `name` into a symbolic linear combination of Mulliken irreps (e.g. `2*A1 + B2`).

operators.name: point_group_from_hm
operators.doc: Converts a Hermann-Mauguin crystallographic point group symbol `hm` to its Schoenflies symbol.

operators.name: point_group_function_irreps
operators.doc: Returns for each of `x, y, z, x^2, y^2, z^2, x*y, x*z, y*z` the irreps of point group `name` in which it transforms.

operators.name: point_group_hm
operators.doc: Converts a crystallographic Schoenflies point group symbol `name` to its Hermann-Mauguin symbol.

operators.name: point_group_ir_active
operators.doc: Returns the Mulliken irreps of point group `name` that are infrared-active (transforming as `x`, `y`, or `z`).

operators.name: point_group_irrep_dimensions
operators.doc: Returns the dimensions of the irreducible representations of point group `name` (`2` for combined complex-conjugate `E` pairs).

operators.name: point_group_irreps
operators.doc: Returns the Mulliken labels of the irreducible representations of point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_is_crystallographic
operators.doc: Returns `true` if point group `name` is crystallographic (all element orders in `{1, 2, 3, 4, 6}`).

operators.name: point_group_multiplicities
operators.doc: Returns the integer multiplicities of class function `chi` aligned with `point_group_irreps(name)`.

operators.name: point_group_order
operators.doc: Returns the order (number of symmetry operations) of point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_raman_active
operators.doc: Returns the Mulliken irreps of point group `name` that are Raman-active (transforming as quadratic forms `x^2`, `xy`, etc.).

operators.name: point_group_rotation_character
operators.doc: Returns the character of the axial rotation `(Rx, Ry, Rz)` representation in point group `name`.

operators.name: point_group_vector_character
operators.doc: Returns the character of the polar vector `(x, y, z)` representation in point group `name`.

operators.name: poisson
operators.doc: `poisson(rate)`: Poisson distribution with rate (mean) parameter `rate`.

operators.name: poisson_bracket
operators.doc: `poisson_bracket(f, g, q, p)`: canonical Poisson bracket `{f, g} = (df/dq)(dg/dp) - (df/dp)(dg/dq)`.

operators.name: poisson_fd
operators.doc: `poisson_fd(rhs, bc_val)`: finite-difference Poisson solver `-Delta u = rhs` on the unit domain with uniform Dirichlet boundary `bc_val`.

operators.name: poisson_fd_bc
operators.doc: `poisson_fd_bc(rhs, bc, bc_val)`: finite-difference Poisson solver `-Delta u = rhs` with per-face Dirichlet/Neumann boundary condition `bc`.

operators.name: poles
operators.doc: `poles(f, z)`: list of `list(p, order)` pairs for the poles of meromorphic `f(z)`.

operators.name: polygamma
operators.doc: `polygamma(n, x)`: `n`-th derivative of the digamma function `psi^(n)(x)`.

operators.name: polygon
operators.doc: `polygon(vertices)`: closed polygonal contour through `list(z1, ..., zn)` in order.

operators.name: polylog
operators.doc: `polylog(s, z)`: polylogarithm `Li_s(z) = sum_{k=1}^infty z^k / k^s`.

operators.name: polynomial_regression
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Int>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Float>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Float>
(Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `polynomial_regression(xs, ys, degree)`: polynomial least-squares fit returning coefficients `list(c0, c1, ..., cd)` up to degree `degree`.

operators.name: polynomial_system_roots
operators.doc: `polynomial_system_roots(system)`: finite roots of a square polynomial system by total-degree homotopy continuation as `list(list(re, im), ...)`.

operators.name: pooled_t_test
operators.doc: `pooled_t_test(xs, ys)`: two-sample pooled t-test returning `list(statistic, p_value)` assuming equal population variances.
examples: pooled_t_test(list(a, b, c), list(c, d, a, d))

operators.name: position_operator
operators.doc: `position_operator(x)`: 1D position operator multiplying by `x`.

operators.name: potential_energy_gravity_uniform
operators.doc: `potential_energy_gravity_uniform(m, h, g)`: gravitational potential energy `m g h` in a uniform field.

operators.name: potential_energy_gravity_universal
operators.doc: `potential_energy_gravity_universal(m1, m2, r, G)`: Newtonian gravitational potential energy `-G m1 m2 / r`.

operators.name: potential_energy_spring
operators.doc: `potential_energy_spring(k, x)`: elastic potential energy `(1/2) k x^2` of a Hookean spring.

operators.name: pow
operators.doc: `base ^ exponent`.

operators.name: power
operators.doc: `power(F, v)`: instantaneous mechanical power `F . v`.

operators.name: power_branch
operators.doc: `power_branch(z, w, k)`: branch `k` of the complex power `exp(w * log_branch(z, k))`.

operators.name: powmod
operators.doc: `powmod(b, e, m)`: modular exponentiation `b^e mod m` for `e >= 0` and `m > 0`.

operators.name: poynting_vector
operators.doc: `poynting_vector(E, B)`: electromagnetic energy flux `(E x B) / mu_0`.

operators.name: presentation_abelianization
operators.doc: Computes the abelianization of a finitely presented group `list(n, relators)` via Smith normal form.

operators.name: pressure_from_helmholtz
operators.doc: `pressure_from_helmholtz(A, V)`: thermodynamic pressure `-dA/dV` from Helmholtz free energy `A`.

operators.name: prevprime
operators.doc: `prevprime(n)`: largest prime strictly less than `n` (for `n > 2`).

operators.name: prime_implicants
operators.doc: `prime_implicants(formula)`: computes the list of prime implicants of propositional `formula`.

operators.name: prime_pi
operators.doc: `prime_pi(n)`: prime-counting function `pi(n)`, the number of primes `<= n`.

operators.name: primes
operators.doc: `primes(n)`: list of all prime numbers `<= n`.

operators.name: primitive_root
operators.doc: `primitive_root(n)`: smallest primitive root modulo `n`, if `(Z/nZ)^*` is cyclic.

operators.name: probability_density
operators.doc: `probability_density(psi)`: probability density `|psi|^2 = conj(psi) * psi`.

operators.name: product
operators.doc: `product(expr, k, lo, hi)`: symbolic/numeric product over bound index `k` from `lo` to `hi`.

operators.name: project
operators.doc: `project(u, v)`: orthogonal projection of vector `u` onto vector `v`.

operators.name: project_onto
operators.doc: `project_onto(f, g, x, a, b)`: orthogonal projection of `f` onto `g` in `L^2([a, b])`.

operators.name: propagator
operators.doc: `propagator(p, m)`: Feynman scalar propagator `i / (p^2 - m^2 + i epsilon)` in momentum space.

operators.name: proportion_z_test
operators.doc: `proportion_z_test(k, n, p0)`: two-sided one-sample z-test `list(statistic, p_value)` for proportion given `k` successes in `n` trials against null `p0`.

operators.name: pullback
signatures: (form, Tensor<1, Symbol>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Symbol>) -> form
operators.doc: `pullback(omega, vars, phi, params)`: pullback `phi* omega` of form `omega(vars)` along map `phi(params)`.
examples: pullback(form(list(list(1, list(1, 2)))), list(x, y), list(r*cos(t), r*sin(t)), list(r, t))

operators.name: q_e
operators.doc: `q_e`: elementary charge in C (exact SI).

operators.name: qcd_lagrangian
operators.doc: `qcd_lagrangian(psibar, psi, G, m, gs)`: symbolic QCD Lagrangian density for quark field `psi` and gluon field `G`.

operators.name: qed_lagrangian
operators.doc: `qed_lagrangian(psibar, psi, A, m, e)`: symbolic QED Lagrangian density for Dirac spinor `psi` and gauge field `A`.

operators.name: qm_apply
operators.doc: `qm_apply(A, psi)`: applies quantum operator `A` to wavefunction `psi`.

operators.name: qp_eq
signatures: (Tensor<2, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<2, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>) -> Tensor<1, Tensor<1, Real>>
operators.doc: `qp_eq(Q, c, A, b)`: solves the equality-constrained quadratic program `min 1/2 x^T Q x + c^T x` subject to `A x = b`.

operators.name: qr
operators.doc: `qr(A)`: QR factorization `list(Q, R)` with orthogonal `Q` and upper triangular `R`.

operators.name: qr_pivoted_diagonal
operators.doc: `qr_pivoted_diagonal(a)`: non-increasing absolute diagonal `|R_ii|` from column-pivoted QR of `a`.

operators.name: qr_pivoted_permutation
operators.doc: `qr_pivoted_permutation(a)`: 0-based column permutation vector `perm` from column-pivoted QR of `a`.

operators.name: qr_pivoted_rank
operators.doc: `qr_pivoted_rank(a, tol)`: numerical rank of matrix `a` from column-pivoted QR diagonal entries above `tol * max(|R_ii|)`.

operators.name: quadratic_residues
operators.doc: `quadratic_residues(n)`: sorted list of nonzero quadratic residues modulo `n`.

operators.name: quantile
operators.doc: `quantile(xs, p)`: `p`-th quantile (interpolated order statistic, `p in [0, 1]`) of list `xs`.

operators.name: quantile_hf
operators.doc: `quantile_hf(data, p, kind)`: sample quantile at probability `p` in `[0, 1]` using Hyndman-Fan definition `kind` (1 to 9).

operators.name: quantile_of
operators.doc: `quantile_of(d, p)`: quantile function (inverse CDF) of distribution `d` at probability `p`.

operators.name: quantity
operators.doc: `quantity(value, unit)`: constructs a dimensional quantity pairing numeric or symbolic `value` with `unit`.

operators.name: quat_conj
operators.doc: Computes the quaternion conjugate `list(w, -x, -y, -z)` of `q`.

operators.name: quat_from_axis_angle
operators.doc: Constructs a unit rotation quaternion `list(cos(theta/2), ax*sin(theta/2), ...)` from `axis` and angle `theta`.

operators.name: quat_inverse
operators.doc: Computes the multiplicative inverse `q* / |q|^2` of quaternion `q`.

operators.name: quat_mul
operators.doc: Computes the Hamilton product `q * r` of two quaternions `list(w, x, y, z)`.
examples: quat_mul(list(w, x, y, z), quat_conj(list(w, x, y, z)))

operators.name: quat_norm
operators.doc: Computes the Euclidean norm `sqrt(w^2 + x^2 + y^2 + z^2)` of quaternion `q`.

operators.name: quat_normalize
operators.doc: Normalizes quaternion `q` to unit length.

operators.name: quat_rotate
operators.doc: Rotates 3D vector `v` by unit quaternion `q` via `q * (0, v) * q*`.

operators.name: quat_slerp
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Int) -> Tensor<1, Float>
(Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Float) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: Computes numeric spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) between quaternions `q1` and `q2` at parameter `t`.

operators.name: quat_to_matrix
operators.doc: Converts quaternion `q` into a 3x3 rotation matrix.

operators.name: quo
operators.doc: `quo(p, q, var)`: returns the polynomial quotient of `p` divided by `q` in `var`.

operators.name: r_squared
operators.doc: `r_squared(actual, predicted)`: coefficient of determination `R^2 = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot` between `actual` and `predicted` lists.

operators.name: radical
operators.doc: `radical(n)`: radical `rad(n)`, the product of the distinct prime factors of `n`.

operators.name: radius_of_convergence
operators.doc: `radius_of_convergence(f, z, a)`: distance from `a` to the nearest singularity of `f(z)` (`oo` if entire).

operators.name: raise_index
operators.doc: `raise_index(W, g)`: contravariant vector `g^ij W_j` obtained by raising index of `W` with inverse of metric `g`.

operators.name: randomized_singular_values
operators.doc: `randomized_singular_values(a, k)`: top `k` singular values of dense matrix `a` via randomized SVD.

operators.name: range_of
operators.doc: `range_of(xs)`: range `max(xs) - min(xs)` of list `xs`.

operators.name: rank
operators.doc: `rank(A)`: rank of matrix `A`.

operators.name: rational_approx
operators.doc: `rational_approx(f, x, a, b)`: AAA barycentric rational approximant of `f(x)` on `[a, b]`.

operators.name: ray
operators.doc: `ray(p, theta)`: half-line `{p + r * exp(I * theta) : r >= 0}` representing a branch cut.

operators.name: ray_plane
operators.doc: Intersects ray `(origin, dir)` with plane `(point, normal)`, returning `list(t, hit_point, normal)` or `false`.

operators.name: ray_sphere
operators.doc: Intersects ray `(origin, dir)` with sphere `(center, radius)`, returning `list(t, hit_point, normal)` or `false`.

operators.name: ray_triangle
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>) -> Bool
operators.doc: Intersects ray `(origin, dir)` with triangle `(a, b, c)`, returning `list(t, hit_point, normal)` or `false`.

operators.name: rayleigh
operators.doc: `rayleigh(sigma)`: Rayleigh distribution with scale parameter `sigma`.

operators.name: re
operators.doc: `re(z)`: real part of complex number `z`.

operators.name: real_integral
operators.doc: `real_integral(f, x)`: real-valued antiderivative of `f` with respect to `x` using `ln(abs(...))` where appropriate.

operators.name: real_qe
operators.doc: `real_qe(formula, vars)`: eliminates quantifiers over `vars` from a first-order real polynomial `formula` via cylindrical algebraic decomposition.

operators.name: real_root_intervals
operators.doc: `real_root_intervals(poly, var)`: returns isolating rational intervals `[lo, hi]` for all real roots of `poly` in `var`.

operators.name: reciprocal_lattice_vectors
signatures: (Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>, Tensor<1, Dyn<term>>) -> Tensor<2, Dyn<term>>
operators.doc: `reciprocal_lattice_vectors(a1, a2, a3)`: reciprocal lattice basis `list(b1, b2, b3)`.

operators.name: reflect
operators.doc: Computes the reflection vector `d - 2 * dot(d, n) * n` of incident vector `d` across unit normal `n`.

operators.name: reflection
operators.doc: Constructs a homogeneous reflection matrix across a line (2D angle or normal) or hyperplane (normal vector).

operators.name: reflection_2d
operators.doc: Constructs a 3x3 homogeneous 2D reflection matrix across the line through the origin at angle `theta`.

operators.name: reflection_3d
operators.doc: Constructs a 4x4 homogeneous 3D reflection matrix across the plane through the origin with normal `list(a, b, c)`.

operators.name: refract
signatures: (Tensor<1, Int>, Tensor<1, Int>, Float) -> Tensor<1, Float>
operators.doc: Computes the numeric Snell-refracted direction for incident vector `d`, normal `n`, and index ratio `eta`, or `false` on total internal reflection.

operators.name: relativistic_energy
operators.doc: `relativistic_energy(m, p)`: relativistic energy `sqrt((p c_0)^2 + (m c_0^2)^2)`.

operators.name: relativistic_momentum
operators.doc: `relativistic_momentum(m, v)`: relativistic momentum `gamma m v`.

operators.name: rem
operators.doc: `rem(p, q, var)`: returns the polynomial remainder of `p` divided by `q` in `var`.

operators.name: rencontres
operators.doc: `rencontres(n, k)`: rencontres number `D_{n, k}`, counting permutations of `n` elements with exactly `k` fixed points.

operators.name: representation_decompose
operators.doc: Decomposes matrix representation `mats` of finite group `G` into multiplicities of irreducible representations.

operators.name: representation_is_valid
operators.doc: Verifies whether matrix list `mats` (aligned with `G`'s elements) satisfies `M(a*b) = M(a)*M(b)` for all pairs.
examples: representation_is_valid(symmetric_group(3), list(list(list(1)), list(list(-1)), list(list(-1)), list(list(1)), list(list(1)), list(list(-1))))

operators.name: residuals
operators.doc: `residuals(xs, ys)`: residuals `y_i - f(x_i)` from simple linear regression on pairs `(xs, ys)`.

operators.name: residue
operators.doc: `residue(f, z, a)`: residue of `f(z)` at point `a`.

operators.name: restrict
operators.doc: `restrict(formula, var, val)`: cofactors `formula` by assigning Boolean constant `val` (`true`/`false`) to `var`.

operators.name: resultant
operators.doc: `resultant(p, q, var)`: computes the Sylvester resultant of polynomials `p` and `q` with respect to `var`.

operators.name: rewrite_with
